segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ تُحَلُّ بِهِ عُقَدُ الْمَكَارِهِ،

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُفْثَأُ بِهِ حَدُّ الشَّدَائِدِ،
segments.transliteration: wa ya man yufthaÊ¾u bihi á¸¥addu l-shadÄÊ¾id,
segments.translation: And O You by Whom the extremes of hardships are removed,

segments.translation: And O You from Whom a way to relief is sought,
The difficulties have yielded to Your power,
And the means have been facilitated by Your kindness,
And by Your power, the decree proceeds,
And all things move according to Your will,
So by Your command, they act without speaking,
And by Your will, they are restrained without Your prohibition,
You are the one called upon for important matters,
And You are the refuge in calamities,

segments.arabic: لَا يَنْدَفِعُ مِنْهَا إِلَّا مَا دَفَعْتَ،

segments.transliteration: wa lÄ yankashifu minhÄ illÄ mÄ kashfta,
segments.translation: Nothing is revealed from them except what You unveil,

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ نَزَلَ بِي يَا رَبِّ مَا قَدْ تَكَأدَنيَّ ثِقْلُهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa qad nazala bÄ« yÄ rabbi mÄ qad takaÊ¾adaniyya thiqluhu,

segments.transliteration: wa allamma bÄ« mÄ qad bahazani á¸¥amluhu,
segments.translation: And the burden of it has caused me pain,
So bless Muhammad and his family,

segments.arabic: وَافْتَحْ لِي يَا رَبِّ بَابَ الْفَرَجِ بِطَوْلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-iftaá¸¥ lÄ« yÄ rabbi bÄba al-faraj bi-á¹­awlik,
segments.translation: And open for me, O Lord, the door of relief by Your power,
And break from me the power of distress by Your strength,
And grant me good perception in what I complain of,
And let me taste the sweetness of good deeds in what I ask,

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَفَرَجاً هَنِيئاً،
segments.transliteration: wa-hab lÄ« min ladunka raá¸¥matan wa-farajan hanÄ«Ê¾an,
segments.translation: And grant me from You mercy and a joyful relief,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مَخْرَجاً وَحِيّاً،
segments.transliteration: wa-jÊ¿al lÄ« min Ê¿indik makhrajan wa-á¸¥iyyan,
segments.translation: And make for me from You a way out and guidance,

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَشْغَلْنِي بِالاهْتِمَامِ عَنْ تَعَاهُدِ فُرُوضِكَ وَاسْتِعْمَالِ سُنَّتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ tashghalnÄ« bil-ihtimÄm Ê¿an taÊ¿Ähudi furÅ«á¸ika wa-istiÊ¿mÄli sunnatika,
segments.translation: And do not occupy me with concern away from fulfilling Your obligations and following Your Sunnah,

And of averting what has befallen me,

segments.transliteration: fa-ifÊ¿al bÄ« dhÄlika wa-in lam astawjibhu minka,

O Possessor of the Great Throne."

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ تُحَلُّ بِهِ عُقَدُ الْمَكَارِهِ ،
segments.translation: 1.O He through whom the knots of detested things are untied!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُفْثَأُ بِهِ حَدُّ الشَّدَائِدِ،
segments.translation: 2.O He through whom the cutting edge of hardships is blunted!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُلْتَمَسُ مِنْهُ الْمَخْرَجُ إلَى رَوْحِ الْفَرَجِ ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa may-yul-tamasu min-hul-makh-raju ilaa raw-h'il-faraj
segments.translation: 3.O He from whom is begged the outlet to the freshness of relief!
4.Intractable affairs yield to Your power,
5.means are made ready by Your gentleness,
6.the decree goes into effect through Your power,
7.and all things proceed according to Your desire.
8.By Your desire they follow Your command without Your word
9.and by Your will they obey Your bans without Your prohibition.
10.You art the supplicated in worries
11.and the place of flight in misfortunes;

segments.transliteration: laa yandafiu' min-haaa il-laa maa dafaa'-t
segments.translation: 12.none of them is repelled unless You repellest,

segments.arabic: وَلا يَنْكَشِفُ مِنْهَا إلاّ مَا كَشَفْتَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa yankashifu min-haaa il-laa maa kashaf-ta
segments.translation: 13.and none is removed unless You removest.

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ نَزَلَ بِي يا رَبِّ مَا قَدْ تَكَأدَنيَّ ثِقْلُهُ ،
segments.transliteration: wa qad nazala bee yaa rab-bi maa qad t-takaa-adanee thiq-luh
segments.translation: 14.Upon me has come down, My Lord, something whose weight burdens me

segments.arabic: وَأَلَمَّ بِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ ،
segments.transliteration: wa alam-ma bee maa qad bahaz'anee h'am-luh
segments.translation: 15.and upon me has fallen something whose carrying oppresses me.
16.Through Your power You hast brought it down upon me
17.and through Your authority You hast turned it toward me.
18.None can send away what You hast brought,
19.none can deflect what You hast turned,
20.none can open what You hast closed,
21.none can close what You hast opened,
22.none can make easy what You hast made difficult,
23.none can help him whom You hast abandoned.
24.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَافْتَحْ لِي يَا رَبِّ بَابَ الْفَرَجِ بِطَوْلِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: wa af-tah' lee yaa rab-bi baabal-faraji bit'aw-lik
segments.translation: 25.open for me, my Lord, the door of relief through Your graciousness,
26.break from me the authority of worry by Your strength,
27.confer the beauty of Your gaze upon my complaint,
28.let me taste the sweetness of benefaction in what I ask,

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَفَرَجاً هَنِيئاً
segments.transliteration: wa hab lee mil-ladunka rah'-mataw-wa farajan hanee-aa
segments.translation: 29.give me from Yourself mercy and wholesome relief,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مَخْرَجاً وَحِيّاً.
segments.translation: 30.and appoint for me from Yourself a quick way out!

segments.arabic: وَلا تَشْغَلْنِي بالاهْتِمَامِ عَنْ تَعَاهُدِ فُرُوضِكَ وَاسْتِعْمَالِ سُنَّتِكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa tash-ghal-nee biiah-timaami a'n taa'ahudi furooz''ik was-tia'-maali sun-natik
segments.translation: 31.Distract me not through worry from observing Your obligations and acting in accordance with Your prescriptions.

segments.arabic: فَقَدْ ضِقْتُ لِمَا نَزَلَ بِي  يَا رَبِّ ذَرْعاً ،
segments.transliteration: faqad z''iq-tu limaa nazala bee yaa rab-bi d'ar-a'a
segments.translation: 32.My capacity has been straitened, my Lord, by what has come down on me,

segments.arabic: وَامْتَلاتُ بِحَمْلِ مَا حَـدَثَ عَلَيَّ هَمّاً ،
segments.transliteration: wa am-talaa-tu bih'am-li maa h'adatha a'lay-ya ham-maa
segments.translation: 33.and I am filled with worry by carrying what has happened to me,

segments.arabic: وَأنْتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى كَشْفِ مَا مُنِيتُ  بِهِ ،
segments.transliteration: wa antal-qaadiru a'laa kash-fi maa muneetu bih
segments.translation: 34.while You hast power to remove what has afflicted me
35.and to repel that into which I have fallen.

segments.arabic: فَافْعَلْ بِي ذلِـكَ وَإنْ لَمْ أَسْتَوْجِبْهُ مِنْكَ ،
segments.transliteration: faf-a'l bee d'alika wa il-lam as-taw-jib-hoo mink
segments.translation: 36.So do that for me though I merit it not from You,
37.O Possessor of the Mighty Throne!

Nor to a disobedience we have perpetrated.

segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ takshif âannÄ sitran satartahu âalÄ ruâÅ«si al-ashhÄd
segments.translation: And do not uncover from us a covering You have concealed over us before witnesses.
On the day You test the reports of Your servants.

segments.arabic: إِنَّكَ رَحِيمٌ بِمَنْ دَعَاكَ، وَمُسْتَجِيبٌ لِمَنْ نَادَاكَ
segments.transliteration: Innaka raá¸¥Ä«mun biman daâÄk, wa-mustajÄ«bun liman nÄdÄk
segments.translation: Indeed, You are Merciful to the one who calls upon You, and Responsive to the one who invokes You.
1.O He remembering whom brings honour to those who remember!
2.O He thanking whom brings triumph to those who give thanks!
3.O He obeying whom brings deliverance to those who obey!
4.Bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَاشْغَلْ قُلُوبَنَا بِذِكْرِكَ عَنْ كُلِّ ذِكْر،
segments.transliteration: wa ash-ghal quloobanaa bid'ik-rika a'n kul-li d'ik-r
segments.translation: 5.and divert our hearts through remembering You from every act of remembrance,

segments.transliteration: wa al-sinatanaa bishuk-rika a'n kul-li shuk-r
segments.translation: 6.our tongues through thanking You from every act of thanksgiving,

segments.transliteration: wa jawaarih'anaa bit'aaa'tika a'n kul-li t'aaa'h
segments.translation: 7.our limbs through obeying You from every act of obedience!

segments.arabic: فَإنْ قَدَّرْتَ لَنَا فَرَاغاً مِنْ شُغُل فَاجْعَلْهُ فَرَاغَ سَلاَمَة
segments.transliteration: faan qad-dar-ta lanaa faraagham-min shugh-lin  faj-a'l-hoo faraagha salaamah
segments.translation: 8.If You hast ordained for us idleness from these occupations, make it an idleness of safety,

segments.arabic: لا تُدْرِكُنَا فِيهِ تَبِعَةٌ وَلاَ تَلْحَقُنَا فِيهِ سَاَمَةٌ
segments.transliteration: laa tud-rikunaa feehee tabia'h wa laa tal-h'aqunaa feehee saa-mah
segments.translation: 9.within which no ill consequence visits us or weariness overtakes us!

segments.arabic: حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ عَنَّا كُتَّابُ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِصَحِيفَة خَالِيَة  مِنْ ذِكْرِ سَيِّئاتِنَا
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa yans'arifa a'n-naa kut-taabus-say-yi-aati bis'ah'eefatin khaaleeatim-min d'ik-ri say-yi-aatinaa
segments.translation: 10.Then the writers of evil deeds may depart from us with a page empty of the mention of our evil deeds,
11.and the writers of good deeds may turn away from us

segments.transliteration: a'n-naa mas-rooreena bimaa kataboo min h'asanaatinaa
segments.translation: 12.happy with the good deeds of ours which they have written.

segments.arabic: وَإذَا انْقَضَتْ أَيَّامُ حَيَاتِنَـا وَتَصَرَّمَتْ مُـدَدُ أَعْمَارِنَـا،
segments.transliteration: wa id'aa anqaz''at ay-yaamu h'ayaatinaa wa tas'ar-ramat mudadu aa'-maarinaa
segments.translation: 13.And when the days of our life have passed by, the terms of our lifetimes have elapsed,

segments.arabic: وَاسْتَحْضَرَتْنَا دَعْوَتُكَ الَّتِي لاَ بُدَّ مِنْهَا وَمِنْ إجَابَتِهَا ،
segments.transliteration: was-tah'-z''arat-naa daa'-watukal-latee laa bud-da min-haa wamin ijaabatihaa
segments.translation: 14.and Your call, which must come and be answered, summons us forth,
15.then bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ خِتَامَ مَا تُحْصِي عَلَيْنَا كَتَبَةُ أَعْمَالِنَا
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l khitaama maa tuh'-s'ee a'lay-naa katabatu aa'-maalinaa
segments.translation: 16.and make the outcome of what the writers of our works count against us

segments.arabic: تَوْبَةً مَقْبُولَةً لا تُوقِفُنَا بَعْدَهَا عَلَى ذَنْب اجْتَرَحْنَاهُ،
segments.transliteration: taw-batam-maq-boolah laa tooqifunaa baa'-dahaa a'laa d'ambin aj-tarah'-naahu
segments.translation: 17.an accepted repentance, which afterwards gave us no rest in a sin that we committed
18.or an act of disobedience that we performed!

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَكْشِفْ عَنَّا سِتْراً سَتَرْتَهُ عَلَى رُؤُوسِ الأشْهَادِ
segments.transliteration: wa laa tak-shif a'n-naa sit-ran satar-tahoo a'laa ru-oosil-ash-haadi
segments.translation: 19.Remove not from us any covering with which You hast covered over the heads of the witnesses
20.on the day when the records of Your servants are tried!

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ رَحِيمٌ بِمَنْ دَعَاكَ، وَمُسْتَجيبٌ لِمَنْ نَادَاكَ .
segments.translation: 21.Verily You art compassionate to him who supplicates You, the responder to him who calls upon You!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ وَ مُنَفِّسَ الْغَمِّ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma yaa faarijal hammi wa munaffisal ghammi
segments.translation: O Allah! O the averter of sorrows. O the dispeller of grief!

segments.arabic: وَ مُذْهِبَ اْلاَحْزَانِ وَ مُجِيْبَ دَعْوَةِ الْمُضْطَرِّيْنَ
segments.transliteration: wa muzhâibal ahâzaani wa mujeeba daâwatil muzâtâarreen.
segments.translation: O the one to ward off the sorrow and O the one to accept the prayers of uneasy people.

segments.arabic: يَا رَحْمٰنَ الدُّنْيَا وَ اْلآخِرَةِ وَ رَحِيْمَهُمَا
segments.transliteration: Yaa rahâmaanad dunyaa wal aakhirati wa rahâeemahumaa
segments.translation: O the Beneficent in this world and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: اَنْتَ رَجائِى وَ رَحْمٰنَ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ
segments.transliteration: anta rajaa-ee wa rahâmaana kulli shai-in
segments.translation: You are my only hope, and O the one to show mercy on everything, have mercy on me.

segments.arabic: فَارْحَمْنِیْ رَحْمَةً تَغْنِيْنِیْ بِهَا عَنْ رَحْمَةٍ مِنْ سِوَاكَ
segments.transliteration: farhâamnee rahâmatan taghneenee bihaa aânr rahâmatim min siwaaka
segments.translation: Shower such a mercy on me which excels every other mercy

segments.arabic: وَ تَقْضِیْ بِهَا عَنِّیْ الدَّيْنَ كُلَّهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa taqzâee bihaa aânnid daina kullah.
segments.translation: and free me from all the debts.[3]

segments.arabic: َللَّهُمَّ اَغْنِني بِحَلالِكَ عَنْ حَرامِكَ، وَ بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِواكَ.
segments.transliteration:
bismil laahirrahmaanir raheem.allaahumma aghnenee behalaalekaaân
haraameka wa befazleka aâmman siwaaka Birahmatik, Yaa Arhamar Raahimeen.
segments.translation:
In the name of Allah the Beneficent the Merciful.
O Allah! Make me self-sufficient by permitted things from prohibited ones and by Your grace from all possessing powers:
O Allah, (please grant me) one of Your looks
by which You may make it easy for my debtors to settle their debts
and for me to recover my loans.
You verily have power over all things.
O Allah, (please) help me pay back to all of Your creatures
their dues for which I am liable,
both the insignificant and the large,
with easiness and wellbeing from Your Presence.
As for the dues that I am too weak to settle,
I am too poor to make up,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَقْوَ عَلَيْهِ بَدَنِي وَيَقِينِي وَنَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: wa lam yaqwa `alayhi badani wa yaqini wa nafsi
segments.translation: and my physique, certitude, and self are too short to satisfy,

segments.arabic: فَادِّهِ عَنِّي مِنْ جَزِيلِ مَا عِنْدَكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
segments.transliteration: fa'addihi `anni min jazili ma `indaka min fadlika
segments.translation: (please) settle them on behalf of me out of the abundant favor You own.

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ لاَ تُخَلِّفْ عَلَيَّ مِنْهُ شَيْئاً تَقْضِيهِ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِي
segments.transliteration: thumma la tukhallif `alayya minhu shay'an taqdihi min hasanati
segments.translation: Then, (please) do not cut off any amount of it from my good deeds.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy!

segments.arabic: اشْهَدُ انْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah,
One and Only and having no associate with Him.

segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger,
the religion is as exactly as He has legislated,
Islam is as exactly as He has described,
the Book is as exactly as He has revealed,
the truth is as exactly as He has said,

segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha huwa alhaqqu almubinu
segments.translation: and Allah is the manifest truth.

segments.arabic: ذَكَرَ ٱللَّهُ مُحَمَّداً وَاهْلَ بَيْتِهِ بِخَيْرٍ
segments.transliteration: dhakara allahu muhammadan wa ahla baytihi bikhayrin
segments.translation: May Allah make good mention of Muhammad and his Household

segments.transliteration: wa hayya muhammadan wa ahla baytihi bilssalami
segments.translation: and may He greet Muhammad and his Household with peace.

segments.arabic: مَنْ مَطَلَ عَلَى ذِي حَقٍّ حَقَّهُ، وَ هُوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَدَاءِ حَقِّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ خَطِيئَةُ عَشَّار.
segments.translation: 112 - O God, suffice me with what is lawful and keep me from what is unlawful, and enrich me with Your grace so that I do not need anyone other than You, O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining.

segments.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّی أَسْأَلُکَ یَا لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ 
بِحَقِّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ 
أَنْ تَرْحَمَنِی بِلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ 
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّی أَسْأَلُکَ یَا لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ 
بِحَقِّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَنْ تَرْضِیَ عَنِّی 
بِلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ 
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّی أَسْأَلُکَ یَا لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ 
بِحَقِّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ 
أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِی بِلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
segments.translation: 113 - Oh God, I ask you, by the right of your guardian, Muhammad ibn Ali, to be gracious to me by your grace and to be generous with him and to be generous to me. Your sustenance, and make what you have permitted sufficient for your forbidden, and you have made it for me to you, for you can do whatever you wish.

From whomever You will, and You honor whomever You will, and You abase whomever You will. In Your hand is all good. Indeed, You are over all things competent. You merge the night into the day, and You merge the day into the night, and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living, and You provide for whomever You will without account.

O Most Merciful of this world and the Hereafter, and Most Merciful of them.
You give from them whomever You wish and withhold from them whomever You wish. Bless Muhammad and his family and clear my debt from me.

115 - Oh God, I ask you, O there is no god but You, in truth.There is no god but You, to have mercy on me, there is no god but You, O God, I ask you, there is no god but You, truly, there is no god but You, to be satisfied with me There is no god but You, O God, I ask you, there is no god but You, by the truth, there is no god but You, to forgive me, there is no god but You.
117 - There is no god but You, Glory be to You. Indeed, I was one of The oppressors -

119 - O Lord, the eyes have fallen asleep and the stars have set, and You are the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Drowsiness and sleep do not overtake You. Neither a dark night nor a resting land nor a deep sea nor layers of darkness, one above another, will be hidden from You. O Hearer of the clear cry of the righteous and O Helper of those who seek Your mercy, I seek help, so bless Muhammad and his family and decide for me. In need, and do not send me back disappointed or deprived, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

title: Hazrat Abbas Ibn Ali ( peace be upon him)
text: Hazrat Abbas Ibn Ali ( peace be upon him)       Ziyarat Hazrat Abbas Ibn Ali(as) Brief info Brief Life × BRotherhood, Courage, and Loyalty in Abbas bin Ali - By SAYYID MUHAMMAD RIZVI Who was Abbas (peace be upon him), whose birth anniversary is being celebrated this week? To the Muslims, Abbas is known in different ways: as the lion of Ali, the hero of Karbala, the flag-bearer of Hussain, the beloved brother of Zainab, and the loving uncle of Sakina (peace be upon them all). Abbas was the son of Imam Ali, the first Imam and successor of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his progeny). He was the brother of Imam Hussain. Fifty years after the demise of the Prophet Muhammad, his grandson Hussain stood up against Yazid, the tyrant ruler of the time, and refused to pledge allegiance to him. As a result of this protest, Hussain, his family-members, and a small group of his companions were surrounded by Yazidi forces in the desert of Karbala, prevented from water for three days, and, finally, on the Day of Ashura, Hussain with about 100 souls faced an army of 25,000 soldiers. They were given the choice of pledging allegiance to Yazid or face death. In that uneven battle, Hussain chose an honorable death over a disgraceful life under a tyrant like Yazid. It was in that historical event that Abbas was made the commander-in-chief and flag-bearer of Hussaini forces. That battle-field gradually turned into a place of pilgrimage, and today the shrines of both these brothers, with their golden domes, form the skyline of Karbala in Iraq. Brotherhood By his supreme sacrifice, Abbas became a universal soul that transcends time and space. Let us start with concept of brotherhood: Brotherhood can be understood on two different levels, a physical and personal level, and a spiritual and social level. Both aspects are important. However, the brotherhood based on blood relationship should be synchronized with the brotherhood based on spiritual relationship. In c

segments.transliteration: salamu allahi wa salamu mala'ikatihi almuqarrabina
segments.translation: O he who saw al-`Abbas attacking the groups of the sheep-like enemies,
followed by the sons of Haydar, who were as courageous as lions.
I have been told that my son was stricken on the head and had his hand cut!
Woe me for my young lion! Did the stroke of the iron post bow his head?

segments.transliteration: walzzakiyatu alttayyibatu fima taghtadi wa taruhu
segments.translation: Had his sword been in his hand, none could have ever approached him.

segments.arabic:
ـبَ بِرَأْسِهِ مَقْطُوعَ يَدْ
وَيْلِي عَلَىٰ شِبْلي أَمَا
لَ بِرَأْسِهِ ضَرْبُ ٱلْعَمَدْ
لَوْ كانَ سَيْفُكَ فِي يَدَيْـ
ـكَ لَما دَنا مِنْهُ أَحَدْ
segments.translation: Do not call me Ummuâl-Banin (Mother of the sons).
You will remind me of the lions of the lair.
I had sons by whom I was called,

segments.transliteration: likhalafi alnnabiyyi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi almursali
segments.translation: but today, I have no single son!
They were four; like eagles on heights.
They faced death by having their aorta cut off.
The ravenous lances crowded on their bodies.
So, all of them were pierced and stabbed.
Great is my distress! Is it true what they have told
that `Abbasâs right hand was severed?
Peace of Allah and peace of His favorite angels,
His commissioned prophets,
His righteous servants,
all the martyrs, and all the veracious (ones),
and also pure, true blessings that come and go,
be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man jahila haqqaka
segments.translation: I testify to you of submission (to the will of God), honest acceptance as true,
loyalty, and sincerity

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man hala baynaka wa bayna ma'i alfurati
segments.translation: to the descendant of the commissioned Prophet, Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household,

segments.arabic: لِخَلَفِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِ
segments.translation: the chosen grandson (of the Prophet),

segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha munjizun lakum ma wa`adakum
segments.translation: the well knowledgeable guide (to the true religion),

segments.transliteration: ji'tuka yabna amiri almu'minina wafidan ilaykum
segments.translation: the conveying successor,

segments.transliteration: wa qalbi musallimun lakum wa tabi`un
segments.translation: and the wrongfully oppressed one.
So, Allah may reward you on behalf of His Messenger,
the Commander of the Faithful,
al-Hasan, and al-Husayn,
peace of Allah be upon them,
with the best reward
for your steadfastness, dedication (to the sake of God), and support (for the right party).

segments.transliteration: inni bikum wa bi'iyabikum min almu'minina
segments.translation: Very excellent be the reward of the eternal life.

segments.transliteration: wa biman khalafakum wa qatalakum min alkafirina
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on him who killed you.

segments.transliteration: qatala allahu ummatan qatalatkum bil-aidi wal-alsuni
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on him who ignored your position
and belittled your sanctity.

segments.transliteration: almuti`u lillahi wa lirasulihi wa li'amiri almu'minina
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on him who precluded you from having from the water of the Euphrates.

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ حَالَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مَاءِ ٱلْفُرَاتِ
segments.transliteration: walhasani walhusayni salla allahu `alayhim wa sallama
segments.translation: I testify that you were killed wrongfully

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
segments.translation: and that Allah will verily fulfill His promise that He made with you.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُنْجِزٌ لَكُمْ مَا وَعَدَكُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa maghfiratuhu wa ridwanuhu wa `ala ruhika wa badanika
segments.translation: O son of the Commander of the Faithful, I have come to you to present myself before you.

segments.arabic: جِئْتُكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلُمْؤْمِنينَ وَافِداً إِلَيْكُمْ
segments.transliteration: ashhadu wa ushhidu allaha annaka madayta `ala ma mada bihi albadriyyuna
segments.translation: My heart is submissive to you and is following you.
And I am your follower.
I am ready to support you
until Allah decides.
He is surely the best of all those who decide.
I am verily with you,
not with your enemy.
I am one of those who believe in you and believe in your Return.

segments.transliteration: wa awfa jaza'i ahadin mimman wa fa bibay`atihi
segments.translation: I also one of those who deny your opposites and killers.
Allah may kill the group who killed you with hands and tongues (by giving orders of killing you.)

segments.arabic: قَتَلَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً قَتَلَتْكُمْ بِٱلأَيْدِي وَٱلأَلْسُنِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah)

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad balaghta fi alnnasihati
segments.translation: and obedient to Allah, to His Messenger, to the Commander of the Faithful,
to al-Hasan, and to al-Husayn, peace and greetings of Allah be upon them.

segments.arabic: وَٱلحَسَنِ وَٱلحُسَيْنِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَسَلَّمَ
segments.translation: Peace, Allahâs mercy, blessings,

segments.transliteration: wa ja`ala ruhaka ma`a arwahi alssu`ada'i
segments.translation: forgiveness, and gratifications be upon you, your soul, and your body.

segments.transliteration: wa a`taka min jinanihi afsahaha manzilan
segments.translation: I testify, and call Allah to witness, that you abided by the same course that was taken by the warriors of (the battle of) Badr

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ وَأُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ أَنَّكَ مَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ مَا مَضَىٰ بِهِ ٱلبَدْرِيُّونَ
segments.translation: and the strivers for Allahâs sake
who sincerely served Him in the battlefields against His enemies,
did their bests for supporting His disciples,
and defended His intimate ones.
So, Allah may reward you the best,

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka lam tahin wa lam tankul
segments.translation: the maximum,

segments.transliteration: wa annaka madayta `ala basiratin min amrika
segments.translation: the most abundant,
and the most conclusive reward that He may give to any one who fulfills his homage,

segments.arabic: وَأَوْفَىٰ جَزَاءِ أَحَدٍ مِمَّنْ وَفَىٰ بِبَيْعَتِهِ
segments.translation: answers the call (of the religion),
and obeys his (divinely elected) leaders.
I testify that you acted extremely sincerely

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قَدْ بَالَغْتَ فِي ٱلنَّصِيحَةِ
segments.translation: and exerted all your efforts (in this regard).
Allah may attach you to the martyrs,

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: add your soul to the souls of the happy ones,

segments.transliteration: wa la tada` li fi hadha almakani almukarrami walmashhadi almu`azzami dhanban illa ghafartahu
segments.translation: give you the largest abode in His Paradise
and the most handsome room,
exalt your mention in `Illiyyin (the most elevated position),
and join you to the Prophets, the veracious ones,
the martyrs, and the righteous ones.
Very excellent is the companionship of such ones.
I testify that you did not lag behind and did not turn away the face,

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تَهِنْ وَلَمْ تَنْكُلْ
segments.transliteration: wa la gha'iban illa hafiztahu wa adnaytahu
segments.translation: and that you left this life with full awareness of the truth,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ مَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa la hajatan min hawa'iji alddunya wal-akhirati
segments.translation: following the examples of the righteous ones

segments.transliteration: laka fiha ridan wa liya fiha salahun
segments.translation: and sticking to the Prophets.
So, Allah may gather us with you,

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya aba alfadli al`abbasa ibna amiri almu'minina
segments.translation: with His Messenger, and with His disciples
in the abodes of those who practiced humbly (with their Lord).
He is certainly the most merciful of all the merciful ones.
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and do not leave for me, in this honored place and glorified shrine, any sin that I did but that You forgive it,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَدَعْ لِي فِي هٰذَا ٱلمَكَانِ ٱلمُكَرَّمِ وَٱلمَشْهَدِ ٱلمُعَظَّمِ ذَنْباً إِلاَّ غَفَرْتَهُ
segments.translation: any care but that You relieve it,

segments.transliteration: ashhadu laqad nasahta lillahi wa lirasulihi wa li'akhika
segments.translation: any illness but that You cure it,
any defect buth that You cover up,
any source of sustenance but that You expand it,
any item of terror but that You pacify it,

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan istahallat minka almaharima
segments.translation: any disunity but that You reunify it,
any absent one but that You guard it and approach (him to me),
and any single need, among the many needs for this life as well as the life to come

segments.arabic: وَلا حَاجَةً مِنْ حَوَائِجِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.translation: whose settlement achieves your gratification and my good,

segments.arabic: لَكَ فِيهَا رِضَىٰ وَلِيَ فِيهَا صَلاحٌ
segments.translation: but that You grant it. O He Who is the most merciful of all the merciful ones!
Peace be upon you, O Abuâl-Fadl al-`Abbas the son of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَاَ ٱلفَضْلِ ٱلعَبَّاسَ بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.transliteration: alrraghibu fima zahida fihi ghayruhu min alththwabi aljazili
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the successors (of the Prophets).

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the foremost to Islam,

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَوَّلِ ٱلْقَوْمِ إِسْلاَماً
segments.transliteration: wa alhaqaka allahu bidarajati aba'ika fi jannati alnna`imi
segments.translation: the first to believe,

segments.transliteration: allahumma inni ta`arradtu liziyarati awliya'ika raghbatan fi thawabika
segments.translation: the best to have served the religion of Allah,

segments.transliteration: wa raja'an limaghfiratika wa jazili ihsanika
segments.translation: and the most careful for Islam.

segments.transliteration: fa's'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa alihi alttahirina
segments.translation: I bear witness that you served Allah, His Messenger, and your brother sincerely.

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ لَقَدْ نَصَحْتَ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلأَخِيكَ
segments.transliteration: wa an taj`ala rizqi bihim darran
segments.translation: You were the most excellent self-sacrificing brother.
So, Allahâs curse be on the group who killed you.
Allahâs curse be on the group who wronged you.
Allahâs curse be on the group who violated your sanctities

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً ٱسْتَحَلَّتْ مِنْكَ ٱلْمَحَارِمَ
segments.translation: and infringed the sanctity of Islam.

segments.transliteration: waj`alni mimman yanqalibu min ziyarati mashahidi ahibba'ika
segments.translation: You were the most excellent steadfast fighter,
protector, supporter,
and brother who defended his brother,
responded to the obedience to his Lord,
and worked desirably for gaining the abundant reward, which others refused,

segments.arabic: ٱلرَّاغِبُ فِيمَا زَهِدَ فِيهِ غَيْرُهُ مِنَ ٱلثَّوَابِ ٱلْجَزِيلِ
segments.transliteration: innaka ahlu alttaqwa wa ahlu almaghfirati
segments.translation: and the nice tribute.
So, Allah may attach you to the rank of your fathers in the gardens of bliss.

segments.arabic: وَأَلْحَقَكَ ٱللَّهُ بِدَرَجَةِ آبَائِكَ فِي جَنَّاتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
segments.translation: O Allah, I have done the pilgrimage to Your disciples out of my desire for (winning) your reward

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي تَعَرَّضْتُ لِزِيَارَةِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ رَغْبَةً فِي ثَوَابِكَ
segments.transliteration: amanna billahi wa birasulihi wa bikitabihi
segments.translation: and my wish for Your forgiveness and Your abundant benevolence.

segments.transliteration: wa bima ja'a bihi min `indi allahi
segments.translation: So, I implore You to send Your blessings upon Muhammad and his immaculate Household

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
segments.translation: and to make my sustenance flow copiously in their names,

segments.transliteration: allahumma la taj`alhu akhira al`ahdi min ziyarati qabra ibni akhi rasulika
segments.translation: my living delightful in their names,
my pilgrimage rewardable in their names,
and my life pleasant in their names,

segments.transliteration: wahshurni ma`ahu wa ma`a aba'ihi fi aljinani
segments.translation: to make me take to the conduct of the honored ones,

segments.transliteration: wa `arrif bayni wa baynahu wa bayna rasulika wa awliya'ika
segments.translation: to make me one of those who, as returning from the pilgrimage to the tombs of Your beloved ones,

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ يَنْقَلِبُ مِنْ زِيَارَةِ مَشَاهِدِ أَحِبَّائِكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: win success and prosperity
and deserve forgiveness of sins,
covering up of defects,

segments.transliteration: walwilayati li`aliyyi bni abi talibin wal-a'immati min wuldihi
segments.translation: and relief of disasters.
You are surely worthy of being feared and worthy of forgiving.

segments.transliteration: fa'inni qad raditu ya rabbi bidhalika
segments.translation: I entrust you with Allah, beseech Him to keep you under His guard,

segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: and invoke peace upon you.
We have believed in Allah, in His Messenger, in His Book,
and in that which he conveyed from Allah.

segments.arabic: وَبِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: O Allah, record our names with the witnesses.

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad jahadta wa nasahta
segments.translation: O Allah, do not decide this pilgrimage to the tomb of the son of Your Messengerâs brother to be the last one of mine.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لا تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ ٱلعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِي قَبْرَ ٱبْنِ أَخِي رَسُولِكَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon him (i.e. the Messenger) and upon his Household.

segments.transliteration: la`ana allahu alzzalimina lakum min al-awwalina wal-akhirina
segments.translation: Grant me opportunities to visit him so long as You keep me alive,
join me to him and to his fathers in the gardens of Paradise,

segments.arabic: وَٱحْشُرْنِي مَعَهُ وَمَعَ آبَائِهِ فِي ٱلْجِنَانِ
segments.translation: and introduce me to him, to Your Messenger, and to Your disciples.

segments.arabic: وَعَرِّفْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِكَ وَأَوْلِيَائِكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, send Your blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and take me to You while I am abiding by the believing in You,
giving credence to Your Messenger,
being faithful to `Ali the son of Abu-Talib and the Imams from his progeny,

segments.arabic: وَٱلوِلاَيَةِ لِعَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَٱلأَئِمَّةِ مِنْ وُلْدِهِ
segments.translation: and disavowing their enemy.
My Lord, I have accepted such.

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي قَدْ رَضِيتُ يَا رَبِّي بِذٰلِكَ
segments.translation: Allah may send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah)
and obedient to Allah and to His Messenger.
I bear witness that you strove (in the way of Allah), acted sincerely,
and tolerated (harm) until death came upon you.
May Allah curse those who wronged you from the past and the present generations

segments.arabic: لَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ لَكُمْ مِنَ ٱلاوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
segments.translation: and may He send them to the lowest layer of the blazing Hell.

segments.translation: O God, bless Muá¸¥ammad and his family (Älih),

segments.arabic: يَا أَللهُ الَّذِي لاَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: YÄ AllÄhu l-ladhÄ« lÄ yakhfÄ âalayh
segments.translation: O God, from Whom nothing is concealed

segments.arabic: شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ،
segments.transliteration: shayâun fÄ« l-ará¸i wa-lÄ fÄ« s-samÄâ,
segments.translation: in the earth nor in the heaven,

segments.arabic: وَكَيْفَ يَخْفى عَلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي مَا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهُ؟
segments.transliteration: wa-kayfa yakhfÄ âalayka yÄ IlÄhÄ« mÄ Anta khalaqtah?
segments.translation: And how can what You created be concealed from You, O my God?

segments.arabic: وَكَيْفَ لاَ تُحْصِي مَا أَنْتَ صَنَعْتَهُ؟
segments.transliteration: wa-kayfa lÄ tuá¸¥á¹£Ä« mÄ Anta á¹£anaâtah?
segments.translation: And how can You not enumerate what You have fashioned?

segments.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَغِيبُ عَنْكَ مَا أَنْتَ تُدَبِّرُهُ؟
segments.transliteration: aw kayfa yaghÄ«bu âanka mÄ Anta tudabbiruh?
segments.translation: Or how can what You administer be absent from You?

segments.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَهْرُبَ مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ حَياةَ لَهُ إلاَّ بِرِزْقِكَ؟
segments.transliteration: aw kayfa yastaá¹­Ä«âu an yahruba minka man lÄ á¸¥ayÄta lahÅ« illÄ bi-rizqik?
segments.translation: Or how can he who has no life except through Your provision be able to flee from You?

segments.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَنْجُو مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ مَذْهَبَ لَهُ فِي غَيْرِ مُلْكِكَ؟

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! أَخْشى خَلْقِكَ لَكَ أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Änak! AkhshÄ khalqika lak aâlamuhum bik,
segments.translation: Glory be to You! The most fearful of Your creation toward You is the one who knows You best,
and the most submissive of them to You is the one who acts most upon Your obedience,

segments.arabic: وَأَهْوَنُهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مَنْ أَنْتَ تَرْزُقُهُ وَهُوَ يَعْبُدُ غَيْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-ahwanuhum âalayk man anta tarzuquhÅ« wa-huwa yaâbudu ghayrak,
segments.translation: and the least significant of them to You is the one whom You provide for while he worships other than You.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! لاَ يُنْقِصُ سُلْطَانَكَ مَنْ أَشْرَكَ بِكَ، وَكَذَّبَ رُسُلَكَ،
segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Änak! LÄ yunqiá¹£u sulá¹­Änak man ashraka bik, wa-kadhdhabu rusulak,
segments.translation: Glory be to You! He who associates partners with You, and denies Your Messengers, does not diminish Your sovereignty,

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ يَسْتَطِيعُ مَنْ كَرِهَ قَضَآءَكَ أَنْ يَرُدَّ أَمْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-laysa yastaá¹­Ä«âu man kariha qaá¸Äâak an yarudda amrak,
segments.translation: and he who dislikes Your decree cannot repel Your command,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَمْتَنِعُ مِنْكَ مَنْ كَذَّبَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ yamtanuâu minka man kadhdhaba bi-qudratik,
segments.translation: and he who denies Your power cannot withhold himself from You,
and he who worships other than You will not escape You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُعَمَّرُ فِي الدُّنْيَا مَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَآءَكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ yuâammaru fÄ« d-dunyÄ man kariha liqÄâak.
segments.translation: and he who disliked meeting You will not be given long life in the world.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ، وَأَقْهَرَ سُلْطَانَكَ،
segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Änak! MÄ aâáºama shaânak, wa-aqhara sulá¹­Änak,
segments.translation: Glory be to You! How immense is Your dignity! And how overwhelming is Your sovereignty!
And how severe is Your power! And how penetrating is Your command!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! قَضَيْتَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ الْمَوْتَ:
segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Änak! Qaá¸ayta âalÄ jamÄ«âi khalqik al-mawt:
segments.translation: Glory be to You! You decreed death upon all Your creation:
both he who affirms Your oneness and he who disbelieves in You,
and everyone is a taster of death,
and everyone is bound for You, so blessed and exalted are You!

segments.arabic: لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكَ،
segments.transliteration: LÄ ilÄha illÄ Ant, waá¸¥dak lÄ sharÄ«ka lak, Ämanutu bik,
segments.translation: There is no god but You, alone, without a partner, I believe in You,
and I affirmed Your Messengers and accepted Your Book,
and I disbelieved in every deity other than You,
and I disassociated myself from whoever worshipped anything other than You.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أُصْبحُ وَأُمْسِي مُسْتَقِلاًّ لِعَمَلِي،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumm innÄ« uá¹£biá¸¥u wa-umsÄ« mustaqillan li-âamalÄ«,
segments.translation: O God, truly I begin my day and enter my evening regarding my deed as small (or insufficient),
confessing my sin, acknowledging my mistakes,
I am humiliated by my transgression against my soul,
My deed has destroyed me, and my caprice has led me to ruin,
and my desires have deprived me.

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ سُؤالَ مَنْ نَفْسُهُ لاَهِيَةٌ لِطُولِ أَمَلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Fa-asâaluka yÄ MawlÄya suâÄla man nafsÅ«hÅ« lÄhiyatun li-á¹­Å«li amalih,
segments.translation: So I ask You, O my Master, the asking of one whose soul is heedless due to the length of his hope,
and whose body is neglectful due to the stillness of his veins,
and whose heart is captivated by the abundance of blessings upon him,

segments.arabic: وَفِكْرُهُ قَلِيلٌ لِمَا هُوَ صَائِرٌ إلَيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-fikruhÅ« qalÄ«lun li-mÄ huwa á¹£Äâirun ilayh,
segments.translation: and whose thought is meager concerning what he is heading toward,

segments.arabic: سُؤَالَ مَن قَدْ غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الاَمَلُ،
segments.transliteration: suâÄla man qad ghalaba âalayhi l-amal,
segments.translation: The asking of one over whom hope has surely prevailed,
and caprice has tempted him, and the world has gotten a strong hold over him,

segments.arabic: وَأَظَلَّهُ الاَجَلُ، سُؤَالَ مَنِ اسْتَكْثَرَ ذُنُوبَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa-aáºallahu l-ajal, suâÄla mani stakthara dhunÅ«bah,
segments.translation: and the term (of death) has overshadowed him, the asking of one who considered his sins many,

segments.arabic: وَاعْتَرَفَ بِخَطِيئَتِهِ، سُؤَالَ مَن لاَ رَبَّ لَهُ غَيْرُكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-aâtarafa bi-khaá¹­Ä«âatih, suâÄla man lÄ Rabba lahÅ« ghayruk,
segments.translation: and acknowledged his mistake, the asking of one who has no Lord other than You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ وَلِيَّ لَهُ دُونَكَ، وَلاَ مُنْقِذَ لَهُ مِنْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ waliyya lahÅ« dÅ«nak, wa-lÄ munqidhÄ lahÅ« minka,
segments.translation: and no protector besides You, and no deliverer from You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ مَلْجَأَ لَهُ مِنْكَ إلاَّ إلَيْكَ .
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ maljaâa lahÅ« minka illÄ ilayk.
segments.translation: and no refuge from You except to You.

segments.arabic: إلهِي أسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْـوَاجِبِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ،
segments.transliteration: IlÄhÄ« asâaluka bi-á¸¥aqqika l-wÄjibi âalÄ jamÄ«âi khalqik,
segments.translation: My God, I ask You by Your right which is incumbent upon all Your creation,

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَ رَسُولَكَ أَنْ يُسَبِّحَكَ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-bi-smika l-âaáºÄ«m illadhÄ« amarta rasÅ«lak an yusabbiá¸¥ak bih,
segments.translation: and by Your Mighty Name with which You commanded Your Messenger to glorify You,

segments.arabic: وَبِجَلاَلِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ الذِي لاَ يَبْلى
segments.translation: and by the Majesty of Your Noble Face which does not waste away,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَتَغَيَّرُ، وَلاَ يَحُولُ وَلاَ يَفْنى،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ yataghayyar, wa-lÄ yaá¸¥Å«lu wa-lÄ yafnÄ,
segments.translation: and does not change, nor move, nor perish,

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.transliteration: an tuá¹£alliya âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Äli Muá¸¥ammad,
segments.translation: that You bless Muá¸¥ammad and the family of Muá¸¥ammad,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُغْنِيَنِي عَنْ كُلِّ شَيْء بِعِبادَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-an tughniyanÄ« âan kulli shayâin bi-âibÄdatik,
segments.translation: and that You make me independent of everything by Your worship,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُسَلِّيَ نَفْسِيْ عَنِ الدُّنْيَا بِمَخَافَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-an tusalliya nafsÄ« âani d-dunyÄ bi-makhÄfatika,
segments.translation: and that You console my soul from the world with my fear of You,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُثْنِيَنِي بِالْكَثِيرِ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-an tuthniyanÄ« bi-l-kathÄ«r min karÄmatik bi-raá¸¥matik,
segments.translation: and that You grant me in return much of Your generosity by Your mercy.

segments.arabic: فَإلَيْكَ أَفِرُّ، و مِنْكَ أَخَافُ، وَبِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ،
segments.transliteration: Fa-ilayk affirr, wa-minka akhÄf, wa-bika astaghÄ«th,
segments.translation: So to You I flee, and from You I fear, and in You I seek aid,

segments.arabic: وَإيَّاكَ أَرْجُو، وَلَكَ أَدْعُو، وَإلَيْكَ أَلْجَأُ،
segments.transliteration: wa-iyyÄka arjÅ«, wa-lak adâÅ«, wa-ilayk aljaâu,
segments.translation: and You I hope for, and to You I call, and to You I seek refuge,

segments.arabic: وَبِكَ أَثِقُ، وَإيَّاكَ أَسْتَعِينُ، وَبِكَ أُؤمِنُ،
segments.transliteration: wa-bika athiq, wa-iyyÄka astaâÄ«n, wa-bika uâminu,
segments.translation: and in You I trust, and Your help I seek, and in You I believe,
and upon You I rely,
and upon Your bounty and Your generosity I depend.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: يَا أَللهُ الَّذِي لاَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ
segments.translation: 1.O God, from whom nothing is concealed

segments.arabic: شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ،
segments.translation: 2.in earth or heaven!

segments.arabic: وَكَيْفَ يَخْفى عَلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي  مَا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهُ؟
segments.transliteration: wa kay-fa yakh-faa a'leeka yaaa ilaahee maaa anta khalaq-tahu?
segments.translation: 3.How should what You hast created, my God, be concealed from You?

segments.arabic: وَكَيْفَ لاَ تُحْصِي مَا أَنْتَ صَنَعْتَهُ؟
segments.transliteration: wakay-fa laa tuh'-s'ee maaa anta s'anaa'-tahu?
segments.translation: 4.How shouldst You not number what You hast made?

segments.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَغِيبُ عَنْكَ مَا أَنْتَ تُدَبِّرُهُ؟
segments.transliteration: aw kay-fa yagheebu a'nka maaa anta tudab-biruhu?
segments.translation: 5.How should what You governest be absent from You?

segments.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَهْرُبَ مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ حَياةَ لَهُ إلاَّ بِرِزْقِكَ؟
segments.transliteration: aw kay-fa yas-tat'eeu' ay-yah-ruba minka mal-laa h'ayaata lahooo il-laa biriz-qika?
segments.translation: 6.How should one who has no life except through Your provision have the ability to flee from You?

segments.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَنْجُو مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ مَذْهَبَ لَهُ فِي غَيْرِ مُلْكِكَ؟
segments.transliteration: aw kay-fa yanjoo minka mal-laa mad'-haba lahoo fee ghay-ri mul-kika?
segments.translation: 7.How should one who has no road except in Your kingdom escape from You?

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! أَخْشى خَلْقِكَ لَكَ أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِكَ،
segments.transliteration: sub-h'aanak akh-shaa khal-qika laka aa'-lamuhum bik
segments.translation: 8.Glory be to You! He among Your creatures who fears You most knows You best,
9.he among them most bent in humility is most active in obeying You,

segments.arabic: وَأَهْوَنُهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مَنْ أَنْتَ تَرْزُقُهُ وَهُوَ يَعْبُدُ غَيْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ah-wanuhum a'lay-ka man anta tar-zuquhoo wa huwa yaa'-budu ghay-rak
segments.translation: 10.and he among them whom You providest while he worships another is most contemptible before You!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! لاَ يُنْقِصُ سُلْطَانَكَ مَنْ أَشْرَكَ بِكَ، وَكَذَّبَ رُسُلَكَ،
segments.transliteration: sub-h'aanak laa yanqus'u sul-t'aanaka man ash-raka bika wakad'-d'aba rusulak
segments.translation: 11.Glory be to You! He who associates others with You and denies Your messengers diminishes not Your authority.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ يَسْتَطِيعُ مَنْ كَرِهَ قَضَآءَكَ أَنْ يَرُدَّ أَمْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa lay-sa yas-tat'eeu' man kariha qaz''aaa-aka ay-yarud-da am-rak
segments.translation: 12.He who dislikes Your decree cannot reject Your command.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَمْتَنِعُ مِنْكَ مَنْ  كَذَّبَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yam-taniu' minka man kad'-d'aba biqud-ratik
segments.translation: 13.He who denies Your power keeps himself not away from You.

segments.transliteration: wa laa yafootuka man a'bada ghay-rak
segments.translation: 14.He who worships other than You escapes You not.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُعَمَّرُ فِي الدُّنْيَا مَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَآءَكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa yua'm-maru fid-dunyaa man kariha liqaaa-ak
segments.translation: 15.He who dislikes meeting You will not be given endless life in this world.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ!  مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ، وَأَقْهَرَ سُلْطَانَكَ،
segments.transliteration: sub-h'aanak maaa aa'-z'ama shaa-nak wa sq-hara sul-t'aanak
segments.translation: 16.Glory be to You! How mighty is Your station, overpowering Your authority,

segments.transliteration: wa sshad-da qoo-watak wa anfad'a am-rak
segments.translation: 17.intense Your strength, penetrating Your command!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! قَضَيْتَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ الْمَوْتَ:
segments.translation: 18.Glory be to You! You hast decreed death for all Your creatures,
19.both him who professes Your Unity and him who disbelieves in You;
20.each one will taste death,

segments.transliteration: wa kul-lu s'aaa-irun ilay-ka fatabaarak-ta wataa'alay-t
segments.translation: 21.each one will come home to You. Blessed art You and high exalted!

segments.arabic: لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكَ،
segments.transliteration: laaa ilaha il-laaa anta wah'-daka laa shareeka lak aaamantu bik
segments.translation: 22.There is no god but Thou, You alone, who hast no associate. I have faith in You,

segments.transliteration: wa s'ad-daq-tu rusulak wa qabil-tu kitaabak
segments.translation: 23.I attest to Your messengers, I accept Your Book,
24.I disbelieve in every object of worship other than You,
25.I am quit of anyone who worships another!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أُصْبحُ وَأُمْسِي مُسْتَقِلاًّ لِعَمَلِي،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-neee us'-bihoo wa um-see mus-taqil-lal-lia'malee
segments.translation: 26.O God, I rise in the morning and enter the evening making little of my good works,
27.confessing my sins, admitting my offenses;
28.I am abased because of my prodigality against myself.
29.My works have destroyed me, my caprice has ruined me,
30.my passions have deprived me.

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ سُؤالَ مَنْ نَفْسُهُ لاَهِيَةٌ لِطُولِ أَمَلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: faas-aluka yaa mawlaaya soo-aala man naf-suhoo laaheeatul-lit'ooli amalih
segments.translation: 31.So I ask You, my Master, the asking of him whose soul is diverted by his drawn out expectations,
32.whose body is heedless because of the stillness of his veins,
33.whose heart is entranced by the multitude of favours done for him,

segments.arabic: وَفِكْرُهُ قَلِيلٌ لِمَا هُوَ صَائِرٌ  إلَيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa fik-ruhoo qaleelul-limaa huwa s'aaa-irun ilay-h
segments.translation: 34.whose reflection is little concerning that to which he is coming home;

segments.arabic: سُؤَالَ مَنْ قَدْ غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الاَمَلُ،
segments.translation: 35.the asking of him whom false expectation has overcome,
36.caprice has entranced, and this world has mastered,

segments.arabic: وَأَظَلَّهُ الاَجَلُ، سُؤَالَ مَنِ اسْتَكْثَرَ ذُنُوبَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa az'al-lahul-ajal soo-aala man is-tak-thara d'unoobah
segments.translation: 37.and over whom death has cast its shadow; the asking of him who makes much of his sins

segments.arabic: وَاعْتَرَفَ بِخَطِيئَتِهِ، سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ رَبَّ لَهُ غَيْرُكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa aa'-tarafa bikhat'ee-atih soo-aala mal-laa rab-ba lahoo ghay-ruk
segments.translation: 38.and confesses his offense; the asking of him who has no Lord but Thou,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ وَلِيَّ لَهُ دُونَكَ، وَلاَ مُنْقِذَ لَهُ مِنْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa walee-ya lahoo doonak wa laa munqid'a lahoo mink
segments.translation: 39.no friend besides You, no one to deliver him from You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ مَلْجَأَ لَهُ مِنْكَ إلاَّ إلَيْكَ .
segments.transliteration: wa laa mal-jaa lahoo minka il-laaa ilay-k
segments.translation: 40.and no asylum from You except in You.

segments.arabic: إلهِي أسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْـوَاجِبِ عَلَى  جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ،
segments.translation: 41.My God, I ask You by Your right incumbent upon all Your creatures,

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَ رَسُولَكَ أَنْ يُسَبِّحَكَ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa bis-mikal-a'z'eemil-lad'eee amar-ta rasoolaka ay-yusab-bih'aka bih
segments.translation: 42.by Your mighty name with which You commanded Your messenger to glorify You,

segments.arabic: وَبِجَلاَلِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ الذِي لاَ يَبْلى
segments.translation: 43.and by the majesty of Your generous face, which ages not,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَتَغَيَّرُ، وَلاَ يَحُولُ وَلاَ يَفْنى،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yataghay-yar wa laa yah'oolu wa laa yaf-naa
segments.translation: 44.nor changes, nor alters, nor passes away,

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.transliteration: an tus'al-leea a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaali muh'am-mad
segments.translation: 45.that You blessest Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُغْنِيَنِي عَنْ كُلِّ شَيْء بِعِبادَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa an tugh-neeanee a'n kul-li shay-im-bii'baadatik
segments.translation: 46.that You freest me from need for all things through worshipping You,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُسَلِّيَ نَفْسِيْ عَنِ الدُّنْيَا بِمَخَافَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa an tusal-leea naf-see a'nid-dunyaa bimakhaafatik
segments.translation: 47.that You distractest my soul from this world through fear of You,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُثْنِيَنِي بِالْكَثِيْرِ  مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa an tuth-neeanee bil-katheeri min karaamatika birah'-matik
segments.translation: 48.and that You turnest me back toward Your abundant generosity through Your mercy!

segments.arabic: فَإلَيْكَ أَفِرُّ، و مِنْكَ أَخَافُ، وَبِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ،
segments.transliteration: faalay-ka afir wa minka akhaaf wa bika as-tagheeth
segments.translation: 49.To You I flee, You I fear, from You I seek aid,

segments.arabic: وَإيَّاكَ أَرْجُو، وَلَكَ أَدْعُو، وَإلَيْكَ أَلْجَأُ،
segments.transliteration: wa ee-yaaka ar-joo wa laka ad-u'w wa ilay-ka al-jaa
segments.translation: 50.in You I hope, You I supplicate, in You I seek asylum,

segments.arabic: وَبِكَ أَثِقُ، وَإيَّاكَ أَسْتَعِينُ، وَبِكَ أُؤمِنُ،
segments.transliteration: wa bika athiq wa ee-yaaka as-tae'en wa bika oo-min
segments.translation: 51.in You I trust, from You I ask help, in You I have faith,
52.in You I have placed my confidence,
53.and upon Your munificence and Your generosity I rely.

segments.translation: O Reliever of anxiety and Remover of sorrow!
O Most Compassionate of this world and the Hereafter, and the Most Merciful of both!

segments.arabic:
1. آية الكرسي (سورة البقرة 2: 255):
اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ.

segments.arabic:
2. سورة الإخلاص (112):
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ.

segments.translation: Say, "He is God, [Who is] One. God, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is begotten, Nor is there to Him any equivalent." (Qur'an 112:1-4)

segments.arabic:
3. سورة الفلق (113):
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ، مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ، وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ، وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ.
segments.transliteration: Qul aâÅ«dhu bi-Rabbi l-falaq. Min sharri mÄ khalaq. Wa-min sharri ghÄsiqin idhÄ waqab. Wa-min sharri n-naffÄthÄti fÄ« l-âuqad. Wa-min sharri á¸¥Äsidin idhÄ á¸¥asad.
segments.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created, And from the evil of darkness when it settles, And from the evil of the blowers in knots, And from the evil of an envier when he envies." (Qur'an 113:1-5)

segments.arabic:
4. سورة الناس (114):
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِكِ النَّاسِ، إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ، مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ.

Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers in the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind." (Qur'an 114:1-6)

I ask You from the good of a Book that has passed (or been decreed) and I seek refuge in You

I ask You for the fear of those who worship You,

and the certainty of those who rely upon You,
and the reliance of the believers upon You.
O God, make my desire in my petition
like the desire of Your friends in their petitions,
and my dread like the dread of Your friends,
and employ me in Your pleasure,
with a deed by which I do not abandon anything of Your religion,

segments.arabic: وَأَظْهِرْ فِيهَا عُذْرِي، وَلَقِّنِي فِيهَا حُجَّتِي وَعَافِ فِيْهَا جَسَدِيْ.

segments.translation: O God, whoever begins his day having a trust or hope other than You,

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumm man aá¹£baá¸¥a lahÅ« thiqatun aw rajÄâun ghayruk,

and my hope in all affairs,
so decree for me the best outcome for them,
and save me from the misguiding trials (or temptations),
by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones.
And may God bless our Master Muá¸¥ammad, the Chosen Messenger of God,

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّد رُسُولِ اللهِ المُصْطَفَى،
segments.transliteration: Wa-á¹£allÄ AllÄhu âalÄ SayyidinÄ Muá¸¥ammad RasÅ«li llÄhi l-Muá¹£á¹­afÄ,
segments.translation: and upon his pure family.
1.O Reliever of worry! O Remover of grief!
2.O Merciful in this world and the next and Compassionate in both!
3.Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
4.relieve my worry, and remove my grief!
5.O One, O Unique, O Eternal Refuge!

segments.arabic: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا أَحَدُ، يَا صَمَدُ،
segments.transliteration: yaa waah'idu yaaa ah'adu yaa s'amad
segments.translation: 6.O He Who has not begotten, nor has been begotten,
7.and equal to Him is not any one!
8.Preserve me, purify me, and take away my affliction!
10.O God, I ask You with the asking of him whose neediness is intense,

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-neee as-aluka soo-aala man ishtad-dat faaqatuh
segments.translation: 11.whose strength is frail, whose sins are many,

segments.transliteration: wa z''au'fat qoo-watuh wa kathurat d'unoobuh
segments.translation: 12.the asking of one who finds no helper in his neediness,

segments.arabic: سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ يَجِدُ لِفَاقَتِهِ مُغِيْثاً،
segments.translation: 13.no strengthener in his frailty,
14.no forgiver of his sin other than You,
15.O Possessor of majesty and munificence!
16.I ask of You a work through which You wilt love him who works it

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ عَمَلاً تُحِبُّ بِهِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: as-aluk a'malana tuh'ib-bu bihee man a'mila bih
segments.translation: 17.and a certainty by which You wilt profit him who is certain

segments.arabic: وَيَقِيناً تَنْفَعُ بِهِ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَنَ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa yaqeenana tanfau' bihee mani as-tay-qana bihee
segments.translation: 18.with the truth of certainty concerning the execution of Your command!
19.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.translation: 20.take my soul while it is firm in sincerity,
21.cut off my need for this world,
22.make my desire for what is with You
23.become a yearning to meet You,
24.and give me true confidence in You!
25.I ask of You the good of the writ that has been made and I seek refuge with You

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ كِتَاب قَدْ خَلاَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ
segments.transliteration: as-aluka min khay-ri kitaabin qad khalaa wa au'wd'u bika
segments.translation: 26.from the evil of the writ that has been made.
27.I ask of You the fear of The worshipers,
28.the worship of those humbly fearful of You,
29.the certainty of those who have confidence in You,
30.and the confidence of those who have faith in You.
31.O God, make my desire in my asking
32.like the desire of Your friends in their asking,
33.and my fear like the fear of Your friends!
34.Employ me in Your good pleasure through works
35.in which I will not leave aside anything of Your religion

segments.arabic: عَمَلاً لاَ أَتْرُكُ مَعَهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ دِيْنِكَ
segments.translation: 36.fearing any of Your creatures!
37.God, this is my need, so make my desire for it great,

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ هَذِهِ حَاجَتِي، فَأَعْظِمْ فِيهَا رَغْبَتِي،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma hd'ihee h'aajatee faaa'-z'im feehaa ragh-batee
segments.translation: 38.within it make manifest my excuse, through it instil me with my argument, and by means of it make well my body!

segments.arabic: وَأَظْهِرْ فِيهَا عُذْرِي، وَلَقِّنِي فِيهَا حُجَّتِي وَعَافِ فِيْهَا جَسَدِيْ.
segments.transliteration: wa az'-hir feehaa u'd'-ree wa laq-qinee feehaa h'uj-jatee wa a'afi feehaa jasadee
segments.translation: 39.O God, some rise in the morning having trust or hope in other than You.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَصْبَحَ لَهُ ثِقَةٌ أَوْ رَجَآءٌ غَيْرُكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma man as'-bah'a lahoo thiqatun aw rajaaa-un ghay-ruk
segments.translation: 40.I rise in the morning, and You art my trust
41.and my hope in all affairs,
42.so decree for me those which are best in outcome
43.and deliver me from misguiding trials,
44.O Most Merciful of the merciful!

text: Dua Tawassul- Duas.org       Dua Tawassul Seeking Intercession through Ahlulbayt(as) Signifance of this Duaa Signifance of this Duaa × Shaykh Tusi says, in his book Misbah, that Imam Hassan bin Ali Al Askari (as) wrote this dua'a for Abu Muhammad who requested him to teach him the proper way of reciting salawat. `Allamah al-Majlisi has quoted some books to have mentioned that Muhammad ibn Babawayh reported this supplication of Seeking Intercession (Du`a' al-Tawassul) from the Holy Imams (peace be upon them). Commenting, he added, âWhenever I said this supplication for any matter, I could find the traces of response immediately.â Article on Tawassul The merciful Allah is beseeched in the name of and for the sake of the Holy prophet and his Ahl ul Bayt. who are amongst the best human beings in status with HIM . It is also known as "quick-fulfillment-of-all-legitimate-desires" dua'a. × . segments.arabic: وَبِحُبِّكُمْ وَبِقُرْبِكُمْ ارْجُو نَجَاةً مِنَ ٱللَّهِ

So, be my hope before Allah.

May Allah bless you all

segments.translation: and may Allah curse the enemies of Allah; those who wronged you,
from the past and the last generations.
Respond to us, O Lord of the Worlds!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى ابْنَتِهِ وَ عَلَى ابْنَيْهَا وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِهِمْ أَنْ تُعِينَنِي عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ وَ رِضْوَانِك
segments.translation: Oh Allah send your blessings on Mohammad and his daughter and her children and I ask you for their sake that you help me in your obedience and in pleasing you and

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تُبَلِّغَنِي بِهِمْ أَفْضَلَ مَا بَلَّغْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ إِنَّكَ جَوَادٌ كَرِيمٌ‏
segments.translation: because of them make me attain the loftiest of position near you like your sincere worshipers. Verily you give generously when asked and without asking.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِلاَّ انْتَقَمْتَ بِهِ مِمَّنْ ظَلَمَنِي وَ غَشَمَنِي
segments.translation: Oh Allah I ask you for the sake of Ameer Al Momineen Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) that you take revenge from the people who have oppressed me and are my enemies

segments.arabic: وَ آذَانِي وَ انْطَوَى عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَ كَفَيْتَنِي بِهِ مَئُونَةَ كُلِّ أَحَدٍ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِين
segments.translation: and have troubled me and continue to do so and for his sake make me free from wants so that I should not ask from anyone else, oh the most merciful.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ وَلِيِّكَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِلاَّ كَفَيْتَنِي بِهِ مَئُونَةَ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيد
segments.translation: Oh Allah I ask you for the sake of Ali ibn Hussain (as) that you repel the evil that could occur through satan Â

segments.arabic: وَ سُلْطَانٍ عَنِيدٍ يَتَقَوَّى عَلَيَّ بِبَطْشِهِ وَ يَنْتَصِرُ عَلَيَّ بِجُنْدِهِ إِنَّكَ جَوَادٌ كَرِيمٌ يَا وَهَّاب
segments.translation: and the arrogant and stubborn king who uses his power to torture me and acts like he can win over me because of his army.Verily you give generously when asked and without asking,oh bestower.

segments.translation: that you grant all my internal and external body parts well being ,oh the free giver and generous.

segments.translation: Oh Allah I ask you for the sake of Mohammad ibn Ali (as) that bless me with your favour

segments.translation: and you be the only source of fulfillment of my needs, verily you have power over all things.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ وَلِيِّكَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ إِلاَّ أَعَنْتَنِي بِهِ عَلَى تَأْدِيَةِ فُرُوضِكَ‏
segments.translation: Oh Allah I ask you for the sake of Ali ibn Mohammad (as) that you help me to fulfill my obligations

segments.arabic: وَ بِرِّ إِخْوَانِيَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ سَهِّلْ ذَلِكَ لِي وَ اقْرُنْهُ بِالْخَيْرِ وَ أَعِنِّي عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ يَا رَحِيمُ‏
segments.translation: and thatÂ  I may be useful for myÂ  brothers in faith and make it easy for me so that it would be with good intentions and help me in your obedience through yourblessings, oh merciful. Â

segments.translation: Oh Allah I ask you for the sake of Hasan ibn Ali (as) that you help me for my affairs of the hereafter and that I can obey you and please you

segments.arabic: وَ سَرَرْتَنِي فِي مُنْقَلَبِي وَ مَثْوَايَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ‏
segments.translation: so that I would be glad when I face you on the day of judgment and when I face my last abode through your mercy, oh the most merciful.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ وَلِيِّكَ وَ حُجَّتِكَ صَاحِبِ الزَّمَانِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِلاَّ أَعَنْتَنِي بِهِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ أُمُورِي‏
segments.translation: Oh Allah I ask you for the sake of your Hujjat Sahebuz Zaman (as) that you help me through them in all my affairs

segments.arabic: وَ كَفَيْتَنِي بِهِ مَئُونَةَ كُلِّ مُوذٍ وَ طَاغٍ وَ بَاغٍ وَ أَعَنْتَنِي بِهِ فَقَدْ بَلَغَ مَجْهُودِي‏
