segments.translation: and all the people who mean to me and all the people who are close to me. So be it ,oh the lord of the worlds
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَزِدْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ الْاُمِّيِّ  الْعَرَبِيِّ الْهَاشِمِيِّ الْقُرَشِيِّ الْمَكِّيِّ الْمَدَنِيِّ الْاَبْطَحِيِّ التَّهَامِيِّ، اَلسَّيِّدِ الْبَهِيِّ، اَلسِّرَاجِ الْمُضِيْ ءِ، اَلْكَوْكَبِ الدُّرِّيِّ، صَاحِبِ  الْوَقَارِ وَالسَّكِيْنَةِ، اَلْمَدْفُوْنِ بِالْمَدِيْنَةِ، اَلْعَبْدِ الْمُؤَيَّدِ، وَالرَّسُوْلِ الْمُسَدَّدِ، اَلْمُصْطَفَى الْاَمْجَدِ، اَلْمَحْمُوْدِ الْاَحْمَدِ، حَبِيْبِ اِلٰهِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، وَسَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ، وَخَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ، وَشَفِيْع ِ  الْمُذْنِبِيْنَ، وَرَحْمَةٍ لِلْعَالَمِيْنَ، اَبِي الْقَاسِمِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ  عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهِ۔
segments.translation: O' Allah! Send blessing, peace and increase mercy on the unlettered Prophet, an Arab, Hashemite, Qurayshite, a Meccan, and Medinite, a tolerant and a Tuhamite, the glorious master, the luminous light, the sparkling stars, who possess dignity and tranquility, who was buried in Medina,thesupportedservant, the delivered Messenger, the selected and glorified one,  the praised and commended one, the beloved of the Lord of the worlds, the master of the Messengers and the seal of the Prophets, the intercessor for the wrong doers, the mercy to the worlds, the father of Al-Qasim, Muhammad, blessing of Allah be upon him and upon his holy family.

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَا الْقَاسِمِ يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ، يَااِمَامَ الرَّحْمَةِ، يَا شَفِيْعَ الْاُمَّةِ، يَا حُجَّةَ اللهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهِ، يَا سَيِّدَنَا وَمَوْلَانَا اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَا بِكَ اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَا وَجِيْهًا عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَ اللهِ۔
segments.translation: Blessing and peace be upon You, O' the father of Al-Qasim, O' the Messenger of Allah, O' the leader of mercy, O' the intercessor of the nation, O' the proof of Allah on his creations, O' our chief and master, we concentrates, seeking for intercession and means through you to Allah, we presented our demand in this world and in the world Hereafter before you, O' the prominent one before Allah, intercede for us before Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ زِدْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى السَّيِّدِ الْمُطَهَّرِ، وَالْاِمَامِ الْمُظَفَّرِ، وَالشُّجَاعِ الْغَضَنْفَرِ، اَبِيْ شُبَيْرَ وَشَبَرَ، قَاسِمِ  طُوْبىٰ وَسَقَرَ، اَلْاَنْزَعِ الْبَطِيْنِ، اَلْاَشْجَعِ الْمَتِيْنِ، اَلْاَشْرَفِ  الْمَكِيْنِ، اَلْعَالِمِ الْمُبِيْنِ، اَلنَّاصِرِ الْمُعِيْنِ، وَلِيِّ الدِّيْنِ، اَلْوَالِيِ  الْوَلِيِّ، اَلسَّيِّدِ الرَّضِيِّ، اَلْاِمَامِ الْوَصِيِّ، اَلْحَاكِمِ بِالنَّصِّ  الْجَلِيِّ، اَلْمُخْلِصِ الصَّفِيِّ، اَلْمَدْفُوْنِ بِالْغَرِيِّ، لَيْثِ بَنِيْ  غَالِبٍ، مَظْهَرِ الْعَجَاۤئِبِ، وَمُظْهِرِ الْغَرَاۤئِبِ، وَمُفَرِّقِ الْكَتَاۤئِبِ، وَالشِّهَابِ الثَّاقِبِ، وَالْهِزَبْرِ السَّالِبِ، نُقْطَةِ دَاۤئِرَةِ الْمَطَالِبِ، اَسَدِ اللهِ الْغَالِبِ، غَالِبِ كُلِّ غَالِبٍ، وَمَطْلُوْبِ كُلِّ طَالِبٍ، صَاحِبِ الْمَفَاخِرِ وَالْمَنَاقِبِ، اِمَامِ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ، مَوْلَانَا وَمَوْلَى الْكَوْنَيْنِ، اَلْاِمَامِ اَبِيْ الْحَسَنَيْنِ اَميرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ  عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَبِيْ طَالِبٍ صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ۔
segments.translation: O' Allah! Send blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on the purified master, the successful leader, the brave lion, the father of Hasan and Husein, the distributor of Paradise and Hell, who possess wide belly, strong and embolden, firm integrity, the obvious scholar, the helper and patron, the guardian of the Religion, the guardian of the guardians, the pleasant master, the leader of the executors, who judge with clear text of the Qur'an, who possess clear sincerity, who was buried in Garriy(The very place Imam Ali was buried in the holy city of Najaf), lion the son of the conqueror, the exterior of astonishment, the endorser of every stages, the separator of fashions, the penetrating star, the passive lion, the point of circle of request, the conqueror lion of God, the conqueror of every conqueror, the desire of every needier, the possessor of all pride and high rank, the leader of the east and west, our master and the master of the two worlds, the leader, father of the two Hasan, the commander of the faithful, Ali son of Abi Talib, may the blessing of Allah be on him.

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَا الْحَسَنِ، يَااَمِيْرَالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، يَا عَلِيَّ بْنَ اَبِيْ طَالِبٍ، يَا اَخَ الرَّسُوْلِ، يَازَوْجَ الْبَتُوْلِ، يَا اَبَا السِّبْطَيْنِ، يَا حُجَّةَ اللهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهِ، يَاسَيِّدَنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا، اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَا بِكَ اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَا وَجِيْهًا عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَ اللهِ۔
segments.translation: Blessing and peace be upon you, O' the commander of the faithful, O' Ali son of Abi Talib, O' the brother of the Messenger, O' the husband of the Batool lady, the father of the two grand sons, the proof of Allah on His creation, O' our chief and master, we concentrates, seeking intercession, and means from Allah through you, and we present our demand in this world and in the world Hereafter before you, O' the prominent one before Allah, intercede for us before Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ زِدْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى السَّيِّدَةِ الْجَلِيْلَةِ الْجَمِيْلَةِ، اَلْمَعْصُوْمَةِ الْمَظْلُوْمَةِ، اَلْكَرِيْمَةِ النَّبِيْلَةِ، اَلْمَكْرُوْبَةِالْعَلِيْلَةِ، ذَاتِ الْاَحْزَانِ الطَّوِيْلَةِ فِي الْمُدَّةِ الْقَلِيْلَةِ، اَلرَّضِيَّةِ الْحَلِيْمَةِ، اَلْعَفِيْفَةِ السَّلِيْمَةِ، اَلْمَجْهُوْلَةِ قَدْرًا، وَالْمَخْفِيَّةِ قَبْرًا، اَلْمَدْفُوْنَةِ سِرًّا، وَالْمَغْصُوْبَةِ جَهْرًا، سَيِّدَةِ النِّسَاۤءِ، اَلْاِنْسِيَّةِالْحَوْرَاۤءِ، اُمِّ الْاَئِمَّةِ النُّقَبَاۤءِ النُّجَبَاۤءِ، بِنْتِ خَيْرِ الْاَنْبِيَاۤءِ، اَلطَّاهِرَةِ الْمُطَهَّرَةِ، اَلْبَتُوْلِ الْعَذْرَاۤءِ، فَاطِمَةَ التَّقِيَّةِ الزَّهْرَاۤءِ عَلَيْهَا السَّلَامُ۔
segments.translation: O' Allah! Send blessing, peace and increase mercy on the splendid and beautiful princess, the infallible and the oppressed one, the noble and magnanimous one, the pleasant who has suffered a lot from the hand of the mischievous ones, who has long grief in a short period of time, the pleasant and tolerant, the modest and perfect, the one whose prestige was not known, who is having hidden grave, who was buried secretly, who was openly usurped, the mistress of the women, the most beautiful among human being, the mother of the excellent and noble leaders, daughter of the best among the Prophets, the pure and purified one, the virgin and maiden one, Fatimah the devout and bosom one, peace be on her.

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلٰى ذُرِّيَّتِكِ يَا فَاطِمَةُالزَّهْرَاۤءُ، يَا بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ، اَيَّتُهَا الْبَتُوْلُ، يَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِ  الرَّسُوْلِ، يَا بَضْعَةَ النَّبِيِّ، يَا اُمَّ السِّبْطَيْنِ، يَا حُجَّةَ اللهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهِ، يَا سَيِّدَتَنَا وَمَوْلَاتَنَا، اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَابِكِ اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَا وَجِيْهَةً عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعِيْ لَنَا عِنْدَ اللهِ۔
segments.translation: Blessing and peace be upon you and your descendants, O' Fatimah the bosom one, O' daughter of Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, O' the virgin one, O' the delight of the eye of the Messenger, O' the flesh of the Prophet, O' the mother of the two grand sons, O' the proof of Allah on His creations, O' our princess and mistress, we concentrate, seeking for intercession and means to Allah through you, and have presented our demands in this world and in the world Hereafter before you, O' the prominent one before Allah, intercede for us before Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ زِدْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى السَّيِّدِ الْمُجْتَبٰى، وَالْاِمَامِ الْمُرْتَجٰى، سِبْطِ الْمُصْطَفٰى، وَابْنِ الْمُرْتَضٰى، عَلَمِ  الْهُدٰى، اَلْعَالِمِ الرَّفِيْعِ، ذِي الْحَسَبِ الْمَنِيْعِ، وَالْفَضْلِ  الْجَمِيْعِ، وَالشَّرَفِ الرَّفِيْعِ، اَلشَّفيعِ ابْنِ الشَّفِيْعِ، اَلْمَقْتُوْلِ  بِالسَّمِّ النَّقِيْعِ، اَلْمَدْفُوْنِ بِاَرْضِ الْبَقِيْعِ، اَلْعَالِمِ بِالْفَرَاۤئِضِ  وَالسُّنَنِ، صَاحِبِ الْجُوْدِ وَالْمِنَنِ، كَاشِفِ الضُّرِّ وَالْبَلْوٰى وَالْمِحَنِ، مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ، اَلَّذِيْ عَجَزَ عَنْ عَدِّ مَدَاۤئِحِهِ  لِسَانُ اللُّسَنِ، اَلْاِمَامِ بِالْحَقِّ الْمُؤْتَمَنِ، اَبِيْ مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَسَنِ (صَلَواتُ اللهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِ )۔
segments.translation: O' Allah, send Your blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on master Al-Mujtaba, the promised leader, the grand son of the chosen one, son of the pleasant one, the banner of guidance, the exalted scholar, the owner of impenetrable reckon and all virtues and exalted honours, the intercessor son of the intercessor, who was assassinated with infusible poison, who was buried in the land of Baqiy, who was acquainted with the obligatory and none obligatory, the possessor of generosity and favour, the detector of open and hidden difficulties, problems and tribulation, whom people's tongue were weak in his praise, the genuine and trustworthy leader, Al-Hasan the father of Muhammad (may Allah's blessing and peace be on him).

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبا مُحَمَّدٍ، يَا حَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ، اَيُّهَا الْمُجْتَبٰى، يَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ، يَابْنَ اَمِيْرِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، يَابْنَ  فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاۤءِ، يَا حُجَّةَ اللهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهِ، يَا سَيِّدَ شَبَابِ اَهْلِ  الْجَنَّةِ، يَا سَيِّدَنَا وَمَوْلَانَا اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَا بِكَ  اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَا وَجِيْهًا عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَ اللهِ۔
segments.translation: May Allah's blessing and peace be upon you, O' the father of Muhammad, O' Al-Hasan son of Ali, O' the chosen one, O' the son of Allah's Messenger, O' the son of the commanderof the faithful, O' the son of Fatimah Zahra, O' Allah's proof on his creations, O' the master of the youth of the Paradise, O' our chief and master, we have concentrated, seeking for intercession and means to Allah through you, and we have presented our demands in this world and in the world Hereafter before you, O' the prominent one before Allah, intercede for us before Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ زِدْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى السَّيِّدِ الزَّاهِدِ، وَالْاِمَامِ الْعَابِدِ، اَلرَّاكِعِ السَّاجِدِ، وَلِيِّ الْمَلِكِ الْمَاجِدِ، وَقَتِيْلِ  الْكَافِرِ الْجَاحِدِ، زَيْنِ الْمَنَابِرِ وَالْمَسَاجِدِ، صَاحِبِ الْمِحْنَةِ وَالْكَرْبِ وَالْبَلَاۤءِ، اَلْمَدْفُوْنِ بِاَرْضِ كَرْبَلَاۤءَ، سِبْطِ رَسُوْلِ  الثَّقَلَيْنِ، وَنُوْرِ الْعَيْنَيْنِ، مَوْلَانَا وَمَوْلَى الْكَوْنَيْنِ، اَلْاِمَامِ بِالْحَقِّ اَبِيْ عَبْدِ اللهِ الْحُسَيْنِ (صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِ )۔
segments.translation: O' Allah, send Your blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on the master of the ascetics, the leader of the worshippers and those that bow and prostrate, the guardian of the king and the glorious one, who was assassinated by the unbelievers and the infidels, the owner of tribulation and affliction, who was buried in the holy land of Karbala, the grand son of the Messenger to men and Jinn, the light of the two eyes of our master and the master of the two worlds, the genuine leader, Al-Husein, the father of Abdullah (may the blessing and peace of Allah be upon him).

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَاعَبْدِاللهِ، يَا حُسَيْنَ بْنَ  عَلِيٍّ، اَيُّهَا الشَّهِيْدُ يَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ، يَابْنَ اَمِيْرِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، يَابْنَ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاۤءِ، يَا سَيِّدَ شَبَابِ اَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، يَا حُجَّةَ اللهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهِ، يَا سَيِّدَنَا وَمَوْلَانَا اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَا بِكَ اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَا وَجِيْهًا عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَ اللهِ۔
segments.translation: May blessing and peace be upon you, O' the father of Abdullah, O' Al-Husein son of Ali,O' the martyred, O' the son of Allah's Messenger, O' the son of the commander of the faithful, O' the son of Fatimah Zahra, O' the chief of the youth in the Paradise, O' Allah's proof on His creations, O' our chief and master, we concentrated, seeking intercession and means to Allah through you, and we have presented our demands in this world and in the world Hereafter before you, O' the prominent one before Allah, intercede for us before Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ زِدْ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى اَبِي الْاَئِمَّةِ، وَسِرَاجِ الْاُمَّةِ، وَكَاشِفِ الْغُمَّةِ، وَمُحْيِى السُّنَّةِ، وَسَنِيِّ الْهِمَّةِ، وَرَفِيْعِ الرُّتْبَةِ، وَاَنِيْسِ الْكُرْبَةِ، وَصَاحِبِ النُّدْبَةِ، اَلْمَدْفُوْنِ بِاَرْضِ طَيِّبَةَ، اَلْمُبَرَّءِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْنٍ، وَاَفْضَلِ الْمُجَاهِدِيْنَ، وَاَكْمَلِ الشَّاكِرِيْنَ وَالْحَامِدِيْنَ، شَمْسِ نَهَارِ الْمُسْتَغْفِرِيْنَ، وَقَمَرِ لَيْلَةِ الْمُتَهَجِّدِيْنَ، اَلْاِمَامِ بِالْحَقِّ زَيْنِ الْعَابِدِيْنَ، اَبِيْ  مُحَمَّدٍ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ (صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِمَا)۔
segments.translation: O' Allah, send Your blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on the father of the Imams, the lamp of the nation, the detector of sorrow, the revival of the Prophetic traditions, who has established determination, the possessor of exalted ranks, who is friendly to tribulations, the possessor of lamentation, who was buried in land of Teebah, who was free from every dishonour, the best of the strugglers, the most perfect among the thanks givers and those that praise Allah,  the midday sun for the repentant, the night moon for the observers of night prayer, the genuine leader and the pretty of the worshippers, Ali son of Al-Husein, the father of Muhammad, (may Allah's blessing and peace be upon both of them)

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ، يَا عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ، يَا زَيْنَ الْعَابِدِيْنَ، اَيُّهَا السَّجَّادُ يَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ، يَابْنَ اَمِيْرِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، يَا حُجَّةَ اللهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهِ، يَا سَيِّدَنَا وَمَوْلَانَا اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَا بِكَ اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَا وَجِيْهًا عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَ اللهِ۔
segments.translation: May Allah's blessing and peace be upon you, O' the father of Muhammad O' Ali son of Al-Husein, O' the pretty of the worshippers, O' he who prostrate much, O' the son of the Prophet, O' the son of the commander of the faithful, O' Allah's proof on His creation, O' our master and chief, we have concentrated, seeking for intercession and means to Allah through you, and we have presented our needs in this world and in the world Hereafter before you, O' the prominent before Allah, intercede for us before Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ زِدْ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى قَمَرِ الْاَقْمَارِ، وَنُوْرِ الْاَنْوَارِ، وَقَاۤئِدِ الْاَخْيَارِ، وَسَيِّدِ الْاَبْرَارِ، وَالطُّهْرِ الطَّاهِرِ، وَالْبَدْرِ الْبَاهِرِ، وَالنَّجْمِ الزَّاهِرِ، وَالْبَحْرِ الزَّاخِرِ، وَالدُّرِّ الْفَاخِرِ، اَلْمُلَقَّبِ بِالْبَاقِرِ، اَلسَّيِّدِ الْوَجِيْهِ، اَلْاِمَامِ النَّبِيْهِ، اَلْمَدْفُوْنِ عِنْدَ جَدِّهِ وَاَبِيْهِ، اَلْحِبْرِ الْمَلِيِّ عِنْدَ الْعَدُوِّ وَالْوَلِيِّ، اَلْاِمَامِ بِالْحَقِّ الْاَزَلِيِّ، اَبِيْ جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِمَاالسَّلَامُ۔
segments.translation: O' Allah, send Your blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on the moon of the moons, the light of the lights, the selected leader, the master of the good ones, the pure and clean one, the splendid moon, the shinning stars, the flowing sea, the excellent pearls, who was nicknamed as Baqir, the prominent master, the noble leader, who was buried close to his father and grandfather, whose school  is filled up with the enemies and the well-wishers, the genuine and continuous leader, Muhammad son of Ali, the father of Ja'afar, peace be on both of them.

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبا جَعْفَرٍ يَا مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ، اَيُّهَا الْبَاقِرُ يَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ، يَابْنَ اَمِيْرِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، يَا حُجَّةَ اللهِ  عَلٰى خَلْقِهِ، يَا سَيِّدَنَا وَمَوْلَانَا اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَا بِكَ اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَا وَجِيْهًا عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَ اللهِ۔
segments.translation: May Allah's blessing and peace be upon you, O' father of Ja'afar, O' Muhammad son of Ali, O' Al-Baqir, O' the son of Allah's Messenger, O' the son of the commander of the faithful, O' Allah's proof on His creations, O' our chief and master, we have concentrated, seeking for intercession and means to Allah through you, and we have presented our demands in this world and in the world Hereafter before you, O' the prominent one before Allah, interceded for us before Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ زِدْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى السَّيِّدِ الصَّادِق ِ الصِّدِّيْقِ، اَلْعَالِمِ الْوَثِيْقِ، اَلْحَلِيْمِ الشَّفِيْقِ، اَلْهَادِيْ اِلَى  الطَّرِيْقِ، اَلسَّاقِيْ شِيْعَتَهُ مِنَ الرَّحِيْقِ، وَمُبَلِّغِ اَعْدَاۤئِهِ اِلَى الْحَرِيْقِ، صَاحِبِ الشَّرَفِ الرَّفِيْعِ، وَالْحَسَبِ الْمَنِيْعِ، وَالْفَضْلِ الْجَمِيْعِ، اَلشَّفِيْعِ ابْنِ الشَّفِيْعِ، اَلْمَدْفُوْنِ بِالْبَقِيْعِ، اَلْمُهَذَّبِ الْمُؤَيَّدِ، اَلْاِمامِ الْمُمَجَّدِ اَبِيْ عَبْدِاللهِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ (صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِ )۔
segments.translation: O' Allah! Send Your blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on the master, Al-Sadiq, the trustworthy one, the firm scholar, the tolerant and the sympathetic one, the guide to the right path, who quench his follower's thirsty with nectar of knowledge, who lead his enemies to Hell fire, the possessor of an exalted honour and impenetrable lineage, he who obtained all virtues, the intercessor son of an intercessor, who was buried in the land of Baqiy, the trained and supported one, the praised leader, Ja'afar son of Muhammad, the father of Abdullah (may Allah's blessing and peace be upon him).

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ، يَا جَعْفَرَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ، اَيُّهَا الصَّادِقُ يَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ، يَابْنَ اَمِيْرِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، يَا حُجَّةَ اللهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهِ، يَا سَيِّدَنَا وَمَوْلَانَا اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَا بِكَ اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ  حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَا وَجِيْهًا عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَاللهِ۔
segments.translation: May Allah's blessing be upon you, O' the father of Abdullah, O' Ja'afar son of Muhammad, O' Al-Sadiq, O' the Prophet's son, O' the son of the commander of the faithful, O' Allah's proof on His creations, O' our chief and master, we concentrated, seeking for intercession and means to Allah through you, and we presented our demands in this world and in the world Hereafter before you, O' the prominent one before Allah, intercede for us before Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ زِدْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى السَّيِّدِ الْكَرِيْمِ، وَالْاِمَامِ الْحَلِيْمِ، وَسَمِيِّ الْكَلِيْمِ، اَلصَّابِرِ الْكَظِيْمِ، قَاۤئِدِ الْجَيْشِ، اَلْمَدْفُوْنِ بِمَقَابِرِ قُرَيْشٍ، صَاحِبِ الشَّرَفِ الْاَنْوَرِ، وَالْمَجْدِ الْاَظْهَرِ، وَالْجَبِيْنِ الْاَطْهَرِ [الْاَزْهَرِ]، اَلْاِمَامِ  بِالْحَقِّ اَبِيْ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ مُوْسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ (صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ وَسَلَامُهُ  عَلَيْهِ )۔
segments.translation: O' Allah! Send Your blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on the honourable master, the tolerant leader, whose name is epithet, the tolerant, the suppressor of anger, the leader of the armies, who was buried in the Quraysh grave Yard, the possessor of luminous honour and clear praise, and pure lineage, the true leader, Musa son of Ja'afar, the father of Ibrahim, (may blessing and peace of Allah be upon him).

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَا اِبْرَاهِيْمَ، يَا مُوْسَى بْنَ  جَعْفَرٍ، اَيُّهَا الْكَاظِمُ، وَاَيُّهَا الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ، يَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ، يَابْنَ اَمِيْرِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، يَا حُجَّةَ اللهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهِ، يَا سَيِّدَنَا وَمَوْلَانَا اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَا بِكَ اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَا وَجِيْهًا عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَ اللهِ۔
segments.translation: May blessing and peace be upon you, O' the father of Ibrahim, O' Musa son of Ja'afar' O' Al-Kazim, O' the good servant of Allah, O' the son of Allah's Messenger, O' the son of the commander of the faithful, O' Allah's proof on His creation, O' our chief and master, we concentrated, seeking for intercession and means to Allah through you, and we have presented our demands in this world and in the world Hereafter before you, O' the prominent one before Allah, intercede for us before Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ زِدْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى السَّيِّدِ الْمَعْصُوْمِ، وَالْاِمَامِ الْمَظْلُوْمِ، وَالشَّهِيْدِ الْمَسْمُوْمِ، وَالْغَرِيْبِ الْمَغْمُوْمِ، وَالْقَتِيْلِ الْمَحْرُوْمِ، عَالِمِ عِلْمِ الْمَكْتُوْمِ، بَدْرِ النُّجُوْمِ، شَمْسِ  الشُّمُوْسِ، وَاَنِيْسِ النُّفُوْسِ، اَلْمَدْفُوْنِ بِاَرْضِ طُوْسِ، اَلرَّضِيِّ الْمُرْتَضٰى، اَلْمُرْتَجَى الْمُجْتَبٰى، اَلْاِمَامِ بِالْحَقِّ اَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوْسَى الرِّضَا (صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِ)۔
segments.translation: O' Allah! Send Your blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on the master of the infallible, the oppressed Imam, who was martyred poisonously, the grieved stranger, who was assassinated and the deprived one, the scholar of the concealed knowledge, the luminous stars, the radiant of the suns, who is friendly with souls, who was buried in the holy land of Tus, the pleasant and contented one, the desired and the selected one, the true Imam, Ali son of Musa Al-Rida, the father of Al-Hasan (may Allah's blessing and peace be upon him).

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَا الْحَسَنِ، يَا عَلِيَّ بْنَ  مُوْسَى الرِّضَا، يَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ، يَابْنَ اَمِيْرِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، يَا حُجَّةَ اللهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهِ، يَا سَيِّدَنَا وَمَوْلَانَا اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَا بِكَ اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ  حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَا وَجِيْهًا عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَاللهِ۔
segments.translation: May Allah's blessing and peace be upon you, O' the father of Al-Hasan, O' Ali son of Musa Al-Rida, O' the son of Allah's Messenger, O' the son of the commander of the faithful, O' Allah's proof on His creations, O' our chief and master, we concentrated, seeking for intercession and means to Allah through you, and we have presented our demands in this world and in the world Hereafter before you, O' the prominent one before Allah, intercede for us before Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ زِدْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى السَّيِّدِ الْعَادِلِ  الْعَالِمِ، اَلْعَامِلِ الْكَامِلِ، اَلْفَاضِلِ الْبَاذِلِ، اَلْاَجْوَدِ اَلْجَوَادِ، اَلْعَارِفِ بِاَسْرَارِ الْمَبْدَءِ وَالْمَعَادِ وَلِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ هَادٍ، مَنَاصِ الْمُحِبِّيْنَ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ، اَلْمَذْكُوْرِ فِي الْهِدَايَةِ وَالْاِرْشَادِ، اَلْمَدْفُوْنِ بِاَرْضِ بَغْدَادَ، اَلسَّيِّدِ الْعَرَبِيِّ، وَالْاِمَامِ الْاَحْمَدِيِّ، وَالنُّوْرِ الْمُحَمَّدِيِّ، اَلْمُلَقَّبِ بِالتَّقِيِّ، اَلْاِمَامِ بِالْحَقِّ اَبِيْ جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ۔
segments.translation: O' Allah! Send Your blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on the master, the Just and the scholar, the implementer of Your law and the perfected one, the virtuous, the generous, the best of the openhanded ones, the acquainted one with the mysteries of the beginning and the Hereafter, and for every nation the is a guide, the alternative for the well-wishers on the day when the caller shall call, who was mentioned among the guidance of direction, who was buried in the holy land of Baghdad, the master of the Arabs, the praised Imam, the light of Muhammad, who was named as Taqi, the Imam, Muhammad son of Ali, the father of Ja'afar, peace be on him.

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَا جَعْفَرٍ، يَا مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ، اَيُّهَا التَّقِيُّ الْجَوَادُ، يَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ، يَابْنَ اَمِيْرِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، يَاحُجَّةَ اللهِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهِ، يَا سَيِّدَنَا وَمَوْلَانَا اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَا بِكَ اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ  حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَا وَجِيْهًا عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَاللهِ۔
segments.translation: May Allah's blessing and peace be upon you, O' the father of Ja'afar, O' Muhammad son of Ali, O' Al-Taqi, the openhanded one, O' the son of Allah's Messenger, O' the son of the commander of the faithful, O' Allah's proof on His creation, O' our chief and master, we concentrated, seeking for Your intercession and means to Allah through you, and we have presented our demands in this world and in the world Hereafter before you, O' the prominent one before Allah, intercede for us before Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ زِدْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى الْاِمَامَيْنِ الْهُمَامَيْنِ، اَلسَّيِّدَيْنِ السَّنَدَيْنِ، اَلْفَاضِلَيْنِ الْكَامِلَيْنِ، اَلْبَاذِلَيْنِ الْعَادِلَيْنِ، اَلْعَالِمَيْنِ الْعَامِلَيْنِ، اَلْاَوْرَعَيْنِ الْاَطْهَرَيْنِ، اَلنُّوْرَيْنِ النَّيِّرَيْنِ، وَالشَّمْسَيْنِ الْقَمَرَيْنِ، اَلْكَوْكَبَيْنِ  الْاَسْعَدَيْنِ، وَارِثَيِ الْمَشْعَرَيْنِ، وَاَهْلَيِ الْحَرَمَيْنِ، كَهْفَيِ  التُّقٰى، غَوْثَيِ الْوَرٰى، بَدْرَيِ الدُّجٰى، طَوْدَيِ النُّهٰى، عَلَمَيِ  الْهُدٰى، اَلْمَدْفُوْنَيْنِ بِسُرَّ مَنْ رَأىٰ، كَاشِفَيِ الْبَلْوٰى وَالْمِحَنِ، صَاحِبَيِ الْجُوْدِ وَالْمِنَنِ، اَلْاِمَامَيْنِ بِالْحَقِّ اَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلِيّ  بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ النَّقِيِّ وَاَبِيْ مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَسَنِ (صَلَواتُ اللهِ وَسَلَامُهُ  عَلَيْهِمَا )۔
segments.translation: O' Allah! Send Your blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on the two brave and noble Imams, the two firm masters, the two virtuous ones, the two perfected ones, the two generous ones, the two Just ones, the two scholarly ones, the two good deed ones, the two most pious ones, the two pure ones, the two luminous lights, the two suns and moons, the two stars, the two fortunate ones, the two inheritors of the two sacred places, the owners of the two sacred Mosques, the two cave of those that fear God, the two helper of the creatures, the two luminous moons, the two mountains of knowledge, the two  banners of guidance, whom were buried in Sammarrah, the detectors of tribulations and afflictions, the possessors of generosity and favour, the two true leaders, Ali son of Muhammad Al-Taqi, the father of Al-Hasan, and Al-Hasan the father of Muhammad (blessing and peace of Allah be upon both of them).

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمَا يَا اَبَا الْحَسَنِ وَيَا اَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَيَا عَلِيَّ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَيَا حَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ، اَيُّهَا النَّقِيُّ الْهَادِيْ  وَاَيُّهَا الزَّكِيُّ الْعَسْكَرِيُّ، يَابْنَيْ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ، يَابْنَيْ اَمِيْرِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، يَا حُجَّتَيِ اللهِ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ، يَا سَيِّدَيْنَا وَمَوْلَيَيْنَا اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَا بِكُمَا اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكُمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَاوَجِيْهَيْنِ عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعَا لَنَا عِنْدَ اللهِ۔
segments.translation: May Allah's blessing and peace be upon both of you, O' the father of Al-Hasan and the father of Muhammad, O' Ali son of Muhammad, O' Al-Naqi Al-Hadi and O' Al-Hasan son of Ali, O'Al-Zaki Al-Askari,O' the sons of the Messenger of Allah, O' the sons of the commander of the faithful, O' Allah's proves on the whole of His creations, O' our chiefs and masters, we have concentrated, seeking for intercession and means to Allah through both of you, and we have presented our demands in this world and in the world Hereafter before both of you, O' the prominent ones before Allah, intercede for us before Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ زِدْ وَبارِكْ عَلٰى صَاحِبِ الدَّعْوَةِ النَّبَوِيَّةِ، وَالصَّوْلَةِ الْحَيْدَرِيَّةِ، وَالْعِصْمَةِ الْفَاطِمِيَّةِ، وَالْحِلْمِ  الْحَسَنِيَّةِ، وَالشُّجَاعَةِ الْحُسَيْنِيَّةِ، وَالْعِبَادَةِ السَّجَّادِيَّةِ، وَالْمَاٰثِرِ الْبَاقِرِيَّةِ، وَالْاٰثَارِ الْجَعْفَرِيَّةِ، وَالْعُلُوْمِ الْكَاظِمِيَّةِ، وَالْحُجَجِ الرَّضَوِيَّةِ، وَالْجُوْدِ التَّقَوِيَّةِ، وَالنَّقَاوَةِ النَّقَوِيَّةِ، وَالْهَيْبَةِ الْعَسْكَرِيَّةِ، وَالْغَيْبَةِ الْاِلٰهِيَّةِ، اَلْقَاۤئِمِ بِالْحَقِّ، وَالدَّاعِيْ اِلَى الصِّدْقِ الْمُطْلَقِ، كَلِمَةِ اللهِ وَاَمَانِ اللهِ وَحُجَّةِاللهِ، اَلْغَالِبِ بِاَمْرِ اللهِ، وَالذَّابِّ عَنْ حَرَمِ اللهِ، اِمَامِ السِّرِّ وَالْعَلَنِ، دَافِعِ الْكَرْبِ وَالْمِحَنِ، صَاحِبِ الْجُوْدِ وَالْمِنَنِ، اَلْاِمَامِ بِالْحَقِّ اَبِي الْقَاسِمِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، صَاحِبِ الْعَصْرِ وَالزَّمَانِ، وَخَلِيْفَةِ الرَّحْمَانِ، وَاِمَامِ الْاِنْسِ وَالْجَآنِّ (صَلَوَاتُ  اللهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِ)۔
segments.translation: O' Allah! Send Your blessing, peace and increase Your mercy on the caller to Prophet hood, the influence of the lion (Ali) the infallible of Fatimah, the tolerant of Al-Hasan, the braveness of Al-Husein, the worship of Al-Sajjad, the effects of Al-Baqir, the sign of Al-Ja'afar, the science of Al-Kazim, the proves of Rida, the openhandedness of Taqi, the purity of Naqi, the solemnity of Al-Askari, and the divine occultation, who shall stand with truth, who shall call for absolute truth, the word of Allah, the security of Allah, the proof of Allah, who was overcome with Allah's commandment, who dissolve in the scared of Allah, the open and hidden leader, the defender of tribulations and afflictions, the possessor of generosity and favour, the true Imam, Muhammad son of Al-Hasan, the father of Al-Qasim, the leader of the age and the time, the ambassador of the Most Merciful, the leader of men and Jinn, (may Allah's blessing and peace be upon him).

segments.arabic: اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَصِيَّ الْحَسَنِ، وَالْخَلَفَ  الصَّالِحَ، يَا اِمَامَ زَمَانِنَا، اَلْقَاۤئِمَ الْمُنْتَظَرَ الْمَهْدِيَّ، يَا سَيِّدَنَا وَمَوْلَانَا اِنَّا تَوَجَّهْنَا وَاسْتَشْفَعْنَا وَتَوَسَّلْنَا بِكَ اِلَى اللهِ، وَقَدَّمْنَاكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَاجَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، يَا وَجِيْهًا عِنْدَ اللهِ، اِشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَ اللهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ۔
segments.translation: May the blessing and peace of Allah be upon you, O' the trustee of Al-Hasan, the good ambassador, O' the leader of our time, who shall rise for truth, the awaiting Al-Mahdi, O' our chief and master, we concentrated, and seeking for intercession and means to Allah through you, and we have presented our demands in this world and in the world Hereafter before you, O' the prominent one before Allah, intercede for us before Allah.

segments.arabic:
يَا سَادَتِيْ وَمَوَالِيَّ، اِنِّيْ تَوَجَّهْتُ بِكُمْ، اَنْتُمْ اَئِمَّتِيْ  وَعُدَّتِيْ لِيَوْمِ فَقْرِيْ وَفَاقَتِيْ وَحَاجَتِيْ اِلَى اللهِ، وَتَوَسَّلْتُ  بِكُمْ اِلَى اللهِ، وَبِحُبِّكُمْ وَبِقُرْبِكُمْ اَرْجُوْ النَّجَاةَ مِنَ اللهِ، فَكُوْنُوْا عِنْدَ اللهِ تَعَالٰى رَجَاۤئِيْ، يَا سَادَاتِيْ يَا اَوْلِيَاۤءَ اللهِ  صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ۔

اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ هٰؤُلَاۤءِ اَئِمَّتُنَا وَسَادَتُنَا وَقَادَتُنَا وَكُبَرَاۤئُنَا وَشُفَعَاۤءُنَا، بِهِمْ  اَتَوَلَّى وَمِنْ اَعْدَاۤئِهِمْ اَتَبَرَّءُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ۔

اَللّٰهُمَّ وَالِ مَنْ وَالَاهُمْ، وَعَادِ مَنْ عَادَاهُمْ، وَانْصُرْ مَنْ نَصَرَهُمْ، وَاخْذُلْ مَنْ خَذَلَهُمْ، وَالْعَنْ عَلٰى مَنْ ظَلَمَهُمْ، وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ، وَاَهْلِكْ عَدُوَّهُمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ مِنَ  الْاَوَّلِيْنَ وَالْاٰخِرِيْنَ، اٰمِيْنَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ۔

اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا زِيَارَتَهُمْ، وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ شَفَاعَتَهُمْ، وَاحْشُرْنَا مَعَهُمْ وَفِيْ زُمْرَتِهِمْ وَتَحْتَ لِوَاۤئِهِمْ، وَلَاتُفَرِّقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ اَبَدًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَاۤ اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔
segments.translation:
O' my chiefs and masters, I have concentrated with you all, you are all my leaders and devices the day of my need, indigence and demands before Allah, I take you (all) as a means to Almighty Allah, with love and nearness to you (all) I hope for deliverance from Allah, you should act as my hope before Allah, O' my masters, O' the friends of Allah, may Allah's blessing be on you all.

O' Allah! These are our Imams, masters, leaders, elders, and intercessors, to them I gave allegiance and I denounce their enemies in this world and the world Hereafter.

O' Allah! Be in friend with those that paid them allegiance, and be in enmity with their enemies, help those that render assistance to them and let down those that betray them.

O' Allah! Curse those that oppress them, and hasten their relief and destroy their enemies among the Jinn and the men from the beginning to the end of the time, (Amen), O' the Lord of the worlds.O' Allah! Grant us the opportunity to visit them in this world and grant us their intercession in the world Hereafter, resurrect us within their group, and under their banner, O' Allah don't distinguish between us and them even in a twinkling of eye in this world and in the world Hereafter; with Your Mercy, O' the Most Mercy of the merciful.[1]

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You to send blessings upon Muhammad
the Prophet of Your mercy and the Word of Your Light,

segments.transliteration: wa an tamla'a qalbi nura alyaqini
segments.translation: and to fill in my heart with the illumination of certitude,
my chest with the illumination of faith,
my intellect with the illumination of honest intentions,
my determination with the illumination of knowledge,
my strength with the illumination of work,
my tongue with the illumination of honesty,
my religion with the illumination of clear evidence from You,
my sight with the illumination of brightness,
my hearing with the illumination of wisdom,

segments.transliteration: wa mawaddati nura almuwalati limuhammadin wa alihi
segments.translation: and my faculty of love with the illumination of sincere loyalty to Muhammad and his Household,
peace be upon them,

segments.arabic: حَتَّىٰ أَلْقَاكَ وَقَدْ وَفَيْتُ بِعَهْدِكَ وَمِيثَاقِكَ
segments.transliteration: hatta alqaka wa qad wafaytu bi`ahdika wa mithaqika
segments.translation: so that I, when I meet You, will have fulfilled the pledge and covenant that I made with You
and then Your mercy will encompass me.
O Protector! O Worthy of all praise!
O Allah, bless Muhammad (al-Mahdi)
Your argument in Your land,
Your viceroy in Your countries,
the caller to Your course,
the establisher of Your justice,
the revolting by Your command,
the authority of the believers,
the ruiner of the unbelievers,
the remover of the murk,
the illuminator of the truth,
the speaker with wisdom and honesty,
the perfect Word of You in Your lands,
the vigilant and fearful,
the well-wishing saint,
the ark of salvation,
the sign of guidance,
the light of the peoplesâ sights,

segments.transliteration: wa khayri man taqammasa wa irtada
segments.translation: the best of all those who put clothes on their bodies,
and the unveiler of blindness,
who will fill the lands with justice and equity
as it would be filled up with wrong and unfairness.
You verily have power over all things.
O Allah, bless Your vicegerent
and the son of Your vicegerents the obedience to whom You have made incumbent upon us
and the observance of the right of whom You have made obligatory
and from whom You have removed filth
and whom You have purified with thorough purifying.
O Allah, give him victory and make him the supporter of Your religion
and through him, give victory to Your and his adherents,
followers, and backers.
Include us with them.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ بَاغٍ وَطَاغٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma a`idhhu min sharri kulli baghin wa taghin
segments.translation: O Allah, protect him against the evil of every transgressor and tyrant
and against the evils of all Your creatures.

segments.arabic: وَٱحْفَظْهُ مِنْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ
segments.transliteration: wahfazhu min bayni yadayhi wa min khalfihi
segments.translation: Guard him from ahead of him, behind him,
his right side, and his left side.

segments.arabic: وَٱحْرُسْهُ وَٱمْنَعْهُ مِنْ أَنْ يوُصَلَ إِلَيْهِ بِسُوءٍ
segments.transliteration: wahrus-hu wamna`hu min an yusala ilayhi bisu'in
segments.translation: Watch him and defend him against anything that may cause evil to him.

segments.transliteration: wahfaz fihi rasulaka wa ala rasulika
segments.translation: Save through him Your Messenger and the family of Your Messenger.
Manifest justice through him.
Aid him with victory.
Help his backers.
Frustrate those who intend to disappoint him.
Terminate those who intend to eradicate him.
And, through him, terminate the tyrants of unbelief,
kill the disbelievers, the hypocrites,
and all atheists,

segments.arabic: حَيْثُ كَانُوٱ مِنْ مَشَارِقِ ٱلأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا
segments.transliteration: haythu kanu min mashariqi al-ardi wa magharibiha
segments.translation: wherever they are; in the east or the west of the earth
on the lands or in the oceans,
and, through him, fill in the earth with justice,
manifest the religion of Your Prophet,

segments.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa sallama
segments.translation: blessings and peace of You be upon him and his Household,

segments.transliteration: waj`alni allahumma min ansarihi wa a`wanihi
segments.translation: make me, O Allah, of his supporters, helpers,
followers, and adherents;

segments.arabic: وَأَرِنِي فِي آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ مَا يَأْمُلُونَ
segments.transliteration: wa arini fi ali muhammadin `alayhim alssalamu ma ya'muluna
segments.translation: allow me to see the hopes of the family of Muhammad, peace be upon them, come true,
and the hazards of their enemies come true.
O God of Truth, respond.
O Lord of Glory and Honor!
O most merciful of those who show mercy!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ يَسْتَغِيثُ الْمُذْنِبُونَ،
segments.translation: 1.O God, O He through whose Mercy sinners seek aid!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ إلَى ذِكْرِ إحْسَانِهِ يَفْزَعُ الْمُضْطَرُّونَ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man ilaa d'ik-ri ih'-saanihee yaf-zau'l-muz''-t'ar-roon
segments.translation: 2.O He to the remembrance of whose beneficence the distressed flee!
3.O He in fear of whom the offenders weep!
4.O Comfort of every lonely stranger!

segments.transliteration: wa yaa faraja kul-li mak-roobin ka-eeb
segments.translation: 5.O Relief of all who are downcast and distressed!

segments.transliteration: wa yaa ghaw-tha kul-li makh-d'oolin fareed
segments.translation: 6.O Aid of everyone abandoned and alone!

segments.transliteration: wa yaa a'z''uda kul-li muh'-taajin t'areed
segments.translation: 7.O Support of every needy outcast!

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ الَّذِي وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء رَحْمَةً وَعِلْماً،
segments.translation: 8.You art He who "embracest everything in mercy and knowledge"! (40:7)

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي جَعَلْتَ لِكُلِّ مَخْلُوق فِي نِعَمِكَ سَهْماً،
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee jaa'l-ta likul-li makh-looqin fee nia'mika sah-maa
segments.translation: 9.You art He who hast appointed for each creature a share of Your favours!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ عَفْوُهُ أَعْلَى مِنْ عِقَابِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee a'f-wuhooo aa'-laa min i'qaabih
segments.translation: 10.You art He whose pardon is higher than His punishment!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي تَسْعَى رَحْمَتُهُ أَمَامَ غَضَبِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee tas-a'a rah'-matuhooo amaama ghaz''abih
segments.translation: 11.You art He whose mercy runs before His wrath!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي عَطَآؤُهُ أكْثَرُ مِنْ مَنْعِهِ،
segments.translation: 12.You art He whose bestowal is greater than His withholding!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ اتَّسَعَ الْخَلاَئِقُ كُلُّهُمْ فِي رَحمَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee at-tasaa'l-khalaaa-iqu kul-luhum fee rah'matih
segments.translation: 13.You art He by whose mercy all creatures are embraced!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي لا يَرْغَبُ فِي جَزَاءِ مَنْ أَعْطَاهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee laa yar-ghabu fee jazaaa-i man aa'-t'aah
segments.translation: 14.You art He who desires no repayment by him upon whom He bestows!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ  الَّذِي لا يُفْرِطُ فِي عِقَابِ مَنْ عَصَاهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee laa yuf-rit'u fee i'qaabi man a's'aah
segments.translation: 15.You art He who does not overdo the punishment of him who disobeys You!

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا يَا إلهِي عَبْدُكَ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَهُ بِالدُّعاءِ فَقَالَ:
segments.transliteration: wa ana yaaa ilaahee a'b-dukal-lad'eee amar-tahoo bid-dua'aa-i faqaala:
segments.translation: 16.And I, my God, am Your servant whom You commanded to supplicate and who said:

segments.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، هَا أَنَا ذَا يَا رَبِّ مَطْرُوحٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: lab-bay-ka wa saa'-day-k haaa ana d'aa yaa rab-bi mat'-rooh'um-bay-na yaday-k
segments.translation: 17.I am at Your service and disposal! Here am I, my Lord, thrown down before You.
18.I am he whose back offenses have weighed down!
19.I am he whose lifetime sins have consumed!

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا الَّذِي بِجَهْلِهِ عَصاكَ وَلَمْ تَكُنْ أَهْلاً مِنْهُ لِذَاكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa anaal-lad'ee bijah-lihee a's'aak wa lam takun ah-lam-min-hoo lid'aak
segments.translation: 20.I am he who was disobedient in his ignorance, while You didst not deserve that from him!

segments.arabic: هَلْ أَنْتَ يَا إلهِي رَاحِمٌ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فَأُبْلِغَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ
segments.transliteration: hal anta yaaa ilaahee raah'imum-man daa'aka faab-ligha fid-dua'aa-i?
segments.translation: 21.Wilt Thou, my God, be merciful toward him who supplicates You, that I should bring my supplication before You?

segments.arabic: أَمْ أَنْتَ غَافِرٌ لِمَنْ بَكَاكَ فَأُسْرِعَ فِي الْبُكَاءِ
segments.translation: 22.Wilt You forgive him who weeps to You that I should hurry to weep?

segments.arabic: أَمْ أَنْتَ  مُتَجَاوِزٌ عَمَّنْ عَفَّرَ لَكَ وَجْهَهُ تَذَلُّلاً
segments.transliteration: am anta mutjaawizun a'm-man a'f-fara laka wj-hahoo tad'al-lula?
segments.translation: 23.Wilt You show forbearance toward him who puts his face in the dust before You in lowliness?

segments.arabic: أَم أَنْتَ مُغْن مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ فَقْرَهُ تَوَكُّلاً؟
segments.transliteration: am anta mugh-nim-man shakaaa ilay-ka faq-rahoo tawak-kulaa
segments.translation: 24.Wilt You free from need him who complains to You of his indigent need with confidence?

segments.arabic: إلهِي لاَ تُخيِّبْ مَنْ لا يَجدُ مُعْطِياً غَيْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: ilaahee laa tukhay-yib mal-laa yajidu mua'-t'eean ghay-rak
segments.translation: 25.My God, disappoint not him who finds no bestower other than You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَخْذُلْ مَنْ لا يَسْتَغْنِي عَنْكَ بِأَحَدٍ دُونَكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa takh-d'ul mal-laa yas-tagh-nee a'nka bih'adin doonak
segments.translation: 26.and abandon not him who cannot be freed from his need for You through less than You!
27.My God, so bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُعْرِضْ عَنِّي وَقَدْ أَقْبَلْتُ عَلَيْكَ ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tua'-riz'' a'n-nee waqad aq-bal-tu a'lay-k
segments.translation: 28.turn not away from me when I have turned my face toward You,

segments.transliteration: wa laa tah'-rim-nee waqad raghib-tu ilay-k
segments.translation: 29.deprive me not when 1 have besought You,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَجْبَهْنِي بِالرَّدِّ وَقَدْ انْتَصَبْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-bah-nee bir-rad-di waqadi antas'ab-tu bay-na yaday-k
segments.translation: 30.and slap not my brow with rejection when I have stood before You!
31.You art He who has described Himself by mercy,
32.so bless Muhammad and his Household and have mercy upon me!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ نَفْسَكَ بِالعَفْوِ، فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee sam-may-ta naf-saka bil-a'f-wi faa'-fu a'n-nee
segments.translation: 33.You art He who has named Himself by pardon so pardon me!

segments.arabic: قَـدْ تَرَى يَـا إلهِي فَيْضَ دَمْعِي مِنْ خِيفَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: qad t-taraa yaaa ilaahee fay-z''a dam-e'e min kheefatik
segments.translation: 34.You hast seen, my God, the flow of my tears in fear of You,
35.the throbbing of my heart in dread of You,
36.and the infirmity of my limbs in awe of You.

segments.arabic: كُلُّ ذَلِكَ حَيَاءٌ مِنْكَ لِسُوءِ عَمَلِي,
segments.translation: 37.All this from my shame before You because of my evil works!

segments.arabic: وَلِذَاكَ خَمَدَ صَوْتِي عَنِ الْجَارِ إلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa lid'alik khamada s'aw-tee a'nil-jaa-ri ilay-k
segments.translation: 38.So my voice has become silent, no longer crying to You,
39.and my tongue has gone dumb, no longer whispering in prayer.

segments.arabic: يَا إلهِي فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، فَكَم مِنْ عَائِبَةٍ سَتَرْتَهَا عَلَيَّ فَلَم تَفْضَحْنِي،
segments.transliteration: yaaa ilaahee falakal-h'am-d fakam min a'aa-ibatin satar-tahaa a'lay-ya falam taf-z''ah'-nee
segments.translation: 40.My God, so to You belongs praise! How many of my flaws You hast covered over without exposing me!

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ ذنْبِ غَطَّيْتَهُ عَلَيَّ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa kam min d'ambin ghat'-t'ay-tahoo a'lay-ya falam tash-har-nee
segments.translation: 41.How many of my sins You hast cloaked without making me notorious!

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ شَائِبَة أَلْمَمْتُ بِهَا فَلَمْ تَهْتِكْ عَنِّي سِتْرَهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa kam min shaaa-ibatin al-mam-tu bihaa falam tah-tik a'n-nee sit-rahaa
segments.translation: 42.How many faults I have committed, yet You didst not tear away from me their covering,
43.collar me with their detested disgrace,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ تُبْدِ سَوْأَتِهَا لِمَنْ يَلْتَمِسُ مَعَايِبِي مِنْ جِيْرَتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa lam tub-di saw-aaatihaa limay-yal-tamisu maa'ayibee min jeeratee
segments.translation: 44.or make their dishonour plain to those of my neighbours who search for my defects
45.and to those who envy Your favour toward me!

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْهَنِي ذَلِكَ  عَنْ أَنْ جَرَيْتُ إلَى سُوءِ مَا عَهِدْتَ مِنّي
segments.transliteration: thum-ma lam yan-hanee d'alika a'n an jaray-tu ilaa sooo-i maa a'hit-ta min-nee
segments.translation: 46.But that did not prevent me from passing on to the evil that You knowest from me!

segments.arabic: فَمَنْ أَجْهَلُ مِنِّي يَا إلهِيْ بِرُشْدِهِ
segments.transliteration: faman aj-halu min-nee yaaa ilaahee birush-dihi?
segments.translation: 47.So who is more ignorant than I, my God, of his own right conduct?
48.Who is more heedless than I of his own good fortune?

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَبْعَدُ مِنِّي مِنِ اسْتِصْلاَحِ نَفْسِهِ
segments.transliteration: waman ab-a'du min-nee mini as-tis'-laahee naf-sihi?
segments.translation: 49.Who is further than I from seeking to set himself right?

segments.arabic: حِيْنَ اُنْفِقُ مَا أَجْرَيْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: h'eena unfiqu maaa sj-ray-ta a'lay-ya mir-riz-qika
segments.translation: 50.For I spend the provision You deliverest to me
51.in the disobedience You hast prohibited to me!

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَبْعَدُ غَوْراً فِي الْبَاطِلِ وَأَشَدُّ إقْدَاماً عَلَى السُّوءِ مِنّي
segments.transliteration: wa man ab-a'du ghaw-ran fil-baat'il wa ashad-du iq-daaman a'laas-sooo-i min-nee?
segments.translation: 52.Who sinks more deeply into falsehood and is more intensely audacious in evil than I?

segments.arabic: حِينَ أَقِفُ بَيْنَ دَعْوَتِكَ وَدَعْوَةِ الشَّيْطَانِ،
segments.transliteration: h'eena aqifu bay-na daa'-watika wa daa'-watish-shay-t'aani
segments.translation: 53.For I hesitate between Your call and the call of Satan

segments.arabic: فَـأتَّبعُ دَعْوَتَهُ عَلَى غَيْرِ عَمىً مِنّي فِيْ مَعْرِفَة بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: faat-tabiu' daa'-watahoo a'laa ghay-r a'mam-min-nee fee maa'-rifatim-bih
segments.translation: 54.and then follow his call without being blind in my knowledge of him

segments.arabic: وَلا نِسْيَان مِنْ حِفْظِي لَهُ وَأَنَا حِينَئِذ مُوقِنٌ
segments.transliteration: wa laa nis-yaanim-min h'if-z'ee lah wa ana h'eena-id'im-mooqinum
segments.translation: 55.or forgetful in my memory of him, while I am certain

segments.arabic: بِأَنَّ مُنْتَهَى دَعْوَتِكَ إلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمُنْتَهَى دَعْوَتِهِ إلَى النَّارِ
segments.transliteration: bianna muntahaa daa'-watika ilaal-jan-nah wa muntahaa daa'-watiheee ilaan-naar
segments.translation: 56.that Your call takes to the Garden and his call takes to the Fire!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَعْجَبَ مَا أَشْهَدُ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: sub-h'aanaka maaa aa'-jaba maaa ash-hadu bihee
segments.translation: 57.Glory be to You! How marvellous the witness I bear

segments.arabic: عَلَى نَفْسِي وَاُعَدِّدُهُ مِنْ مَكْتُوْمِ أَمْرِي،
segments.transliteration: a'laa naf-see wa ua'd-diduhoo mim-mak-toomi am-ree?
segments.translation: 58.against my own soul and the enumeration of my own hidden affairs!

segments.transliteration: wa aa'-jabu min d'alika anaatuka a'n-nee
segments.translation: 59.And more marvellous than that is Your lack of haste with me,

segments.transliteration: wa ib-t'aaaw-uka a'm-mua'ajalatee wa lay-sa d'alika
segments.translation: 60.Your slowness in attending to me! That is not because I possess

segments.arabic: مِنْ كَرَمِي عَلَيْكَ بَلْ تَأَنِّياً مِنْكَ لِي،
segments.transliteration: min karamee a'lay-k bal taan-neeam-minka lee
segments.translation: 61.honour with You, but because You waitest patiently for me
62.and art bountiful toward me
63.that I may refrain from disobedience displeasing to You
64.and abstain from evil deeds that disgrace me,

segments.arabic: وَلاَِنَّ عَفْوَكَ عَنّي أَحَبُّ إلَيْكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa lian-na a'f-waka a'n-neee ah'ab-bu ilay-ka min u'qoobatee
segments.translation: 65.and because You lovest to pardon me more than to punish!

segments.arabic: بَلْ أَنَا يَا إلهِي أكْثَرُ ذُنُوباً
segments.transliteration: bal ana yaaa ilaahee ak'tha-ru d'unoobaa
segments.translation: 66.But I, my God, am more numerous in sins,

segments.transliteration: wa aq-bahoo aaathaaraa wa ash-nau' af-a'alaa
segments.translation: 67.uglier in footsteps, more repulsive in acts,
68.more reckless in rushing into falsehood,
69.weaker in awakening to Your obedience,
70.and less attentive and heedful toward Your threats,
71.than that I could number for You my faults
72.or have the power to recount my sins.

segments.arabic: وَإنَّمَا أُوبِّخُ بِهَذا نَفْسِي طَمَعَـاً فِي رَأْفَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa in-namaaa uwab-bikhu bihad'aa naf-see t'amaa'na fee raa-fatik
segments.translation: 73.I only scold my own soul, craving Your gentleness,
74.through which the affairs of sinners are set right,

segments.arabic: وَرَجَاءً لِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي بِهَا فَكَاكُ رِقَابِ الْخَاطِئِينَ.
segments.translation: 75.and hoping for Your mercy, through which the necks of the offenders are freed.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَهَذِهِ رَقَبَتِي قَدْ أَرَقَّتْهَا الذُّنُوبُ،
segments.translation: 76.O God, this is my neck, enslaved by sins,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَعْتِقْهَا بِعَفْوِكَ،
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wa aa'-tiq-haa bia'f-wik
segments.translation: 77.so bless Muhammad and his Household and release it through Your pardon!
78.This is my back, weighed down by offenses,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَخَفِّفْ عَنْهُ بِمَنِّكَ.
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wa khaf-fif a'n-hoo biman-nik
segments.translation: 79.so bless Muhammad and his Household and lighten it through Your kindness!

segments.arabic: يَا إلهِي لَوْ بَكَيْتُ إلَيْكَ حَتَّى تَسْقُطَ أَشْفَارُ عَيْنَيَّ ،
segments.transliteration: yaaa ilaahee law bakay-tu ilay-ka h'at-taa tas-qut'a ash-faaru a'y-nay
segments.translation: 80.My God, were I to weep to You until my eyelids drop off,
81.wail until my voice wears out,

segments.transliteration: wa qum-tu laka h'at-taa tatanash-shara qadamaay
segments.translation: 82.stand before You until my feet swell up,

segments.transliteration: wa rakaa'-tu laka h'at-taa yan-khalia' s'ul-bee
segments.translation: 83.bow to You until my backbone is thrown out of joint,

segments.transliteration: wa sajat-tu laka h'at-taa tatafaq-qaa h'adaqataay
segments.translation: 84.prostrate to You until my eyeballs fall out,
85.eat the dirt of the earth for my whole life,
86.drink the water of ashes till the end of my days,

segments.arabic: وَذَكَرْتُكَ فِي خِلاَلِ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَكِلَّ لِسَانِي
segments.transliteration: wa d'akar-tuka fee khilaali d'alika h'at-taa yakil-la lisaanee
segments.translation: 87.mention You through all of that until my tongue fails,

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ أَرْفَعْ طَرْفِي إلَى آفَاقِ السَّمَاءِ اسْتِحْيَاءً مِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: thum-ma lam ar-faa' t'ar-feee ilaaa aaafaaqis-samaaa-i as-tih'-yaaa-am-minka
segments.translation: 88.and not lift my glance to the sky's horizons in shame before You,

segments.arabic: مَا اسْتَوْجَبْتُ بِذَلِكَ مَحْوَ سَيِّئَة وَاحِـدَة مِنْ سَيِّئـاتِي،
segments.translation: 89.yet would I not merit through all of that the erasing of a single one of my evil deeds!

segments.arabic: وَإنْ كُنْتَ تَغْفِـرُ لِي حِيْنَ أَسْتَوْجِبُ مَغْفِرَتَكَ
segments.transliteration: wa in kunt tagh-firu lee h'eena as-taw-jibu magh-firatak
segments.translation: 90.Though You forgivest me when I merit Your forgiveness

segments.transliteration: wa taa'-foo a'n-nee h'eena as-tah'iq-qu a'f-wak
segments.translation: 91.and pardonest me when I deserve Your pardon,

segments.arabic: فَإنَّ ذَلِكَ غَيْرُ وَاجِب لِيْ بِاسْتِحْقَاق،
segments.transliteration: fa in-na d'alika ghay-ru waajibil-lee bis-tih'-qaaqiw
segments.translation: 92.yet I have no title to that through what I deserve,
93.nor am I worthy of it through merit,

segments.arabic: إذْ كَـانَ جَزَائِي مِنْكَ فِي أَوَّلِ مَا عَصَيْتُكَ النَّارَ;
segments.transliteration: id' kaana jazaaa-ee minka feee aw-wali maa a's'ay-tukan-naar
segments.translation: 94.since my repayment from You from the first that I disobeyed You is the Fire!

segments.arabic: فَإنْ تُعَذِّبْنِي، فَأَنْتَ غَيْرُ ظَالِم لِيْ.
segments.transliteration: fa in tua'd'-d'ib-nee fa anta ghay-ru z'aalimil-lee
segments.translation: 95.So if You punishest me, You dost me no wrong.

segments.arabic: إلهِي فَـإذْ قَـدْ تَغَمَّـدْتَنِي بِسِتْـرِكَ فَلَمْ تَفْضَحْنِي
segments.transliteration: ilaahee faad' qad-tagham-mat-tanee bisit-rika falam taf-z''ah'-nee
segments.translation: 96.My God, since You hast shielded me with Your covering and not exposed me,
97.waited patiently for me through Your generosity, and not hurried me to punishment,

segments.arabic: َو حَلُمْتَ عَنِّي بِتَفَضُّلِكَ فَلَمْ تُغَيِّـرْ نِعْمَتَـكَ عَلَيَّ،
segments.transliteration: wa h'alum-ta a'n-nee bitafaz''-z''ulika falam tughay-yir nia'-mataka a'lay-ya
segments.translation: 98.and shown me clemency through Your bounty, and not changed Your favour upon me
99.or muddied Your kindly acts toward me,

segments.arabic: فَارْحَمْ طُولَ تَضَرُّعِيْ وَشِـدَّةَ مَسْكَنَتِي وَسُوءَ مَوْقِفِيْ.
segments.transliteration: far-h'am t'oola taz''ar-rue'e wa shid-data mas-kanatee wa sooo-a maw-qifee
segments.translation: 100.have mercy on my drawn out pleading, my intense misery, and my evil situation!
101.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
102.protect me from acts of disobedience, employ me in obedience,
103.provide me with excellent turning back [to You], purify me through repentance,
104.strengthen me through preservation from sin, set me right through well being,
105.let me taste the sweetness of forgiveness,

segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-nee t'aleeqa a'f-wika wa a'teeqa rah'-matik
segments.translation: 106.make me the freedman of Your pardon and the slave released by Your mercy,
107.and write for me a security from Your displeasure!

segments.arabic: وَبَشِّرْنِي بِذلِكَ فِي الْعَاجِلِ دُونَ الآجِلِ بُشْرى أَعْرِفُهَا
segments.transliteration: wa bash-shir-nee bid'alika fil-a'ajili doonal-aaajili bush-raaa aa'-rifuhaa
segments.translation: 108.Give me the good news of that in the immediate, not the deferred - a good news I recognize -
109.and make known to me therein a sign which I may clearly see!

segments.arabic: إنَّ ذلِكَ لاَ يَضيقُ عَلَيْكَ فِي وُسْعِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: in-na d'alik laa yaz''eequ a'lay-ka fee wus-i'k
segments.translation: 110.That will not constrain You in Your plenty,
111.distress You in Your power,
112.ascend beyond Your lack of haste,

segments.arabic: وَلا يَؤودُك فِي جَزِيلِ هِباتِكَ الَّتِي دَلَّتْ عَلَيْهَا آيَاتُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laa yaw-uduka fee jazeeli hibaatikal-latee dal-lat a'lay-haaa aaayaatuk
segments.translation: 113.or tire You in Your great gifts, which are pointed to by Your signs.

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ تَفْعَلُ مَا تَشَاءُ وَتَحكُمُ مَا تُرِيدُ،
segments.transliteration: in-naka taf-a'lu maa tashaaa- wa tah'-kumu maa tureed
segments.translation: 114.Verily You dost what You wilt, You decreest what You desirest.
115."Thou art powerful over everything". (3:26)
